source_url or \"direct_input\"\n\n        # Step 4: 信息加工（本方法外处理，此处标记完成）\n        chain.step4_info_process = True\n\n        # Step 5: 协作校验（P03⊗P04⊗P08量子纠缠态）\n        chain.step5_collab_check = True\n\n        return chain\n\n    def _hash_chain(self, chain: DecisionChain) -> str:\n        data = f\"{chain.step1_dna_auth}{chain.step2_fuse_check}{chain.step3_source_attr}{chain.step4_info_process}{chain.step5_collab_check}{chain.step6_output_sign}\"\n        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n    # ═══ 多维权重计算 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _calculate_weight(self, source_url: str, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维权重: 源可信度(30) + 内容质量(30) + 交叉验证(20) + 时效性(20)\n        返回: (weight_0_to_1, audit_score_0_to_100)\n        \"\"\"\n        score = 0\n\n        # 维度1: 源可信度 (0-30)\n        src_score = self._score_source(source_url)\n        score += src_score\n\n        # 维度2: 内容质量 (0-30)\n        quality = self._score_content_quality(raw_text, key_points)\n        score += quality\n\n        # 维度3: 交叉验证 (0-20) — 与已有知识节点的关联度\n        cross_score = min(20, len(self._find_cross_refs(key_points)) * 4)\n        score += cross_score\n\n        # 维度4: 时效性 (0-20) — 文本中含年份信息加分\n        temporal = self._score_temporal(raw_text)\n        score += temporal\n\n        weight = round(score / 100.0, 3)\n        return weight, score\n\n    def _score_source(self, source_url: str) -> int:\n        if not source_url or source_url == \"direct_input\":\n            return 15   # 直接输入，中性\n        trust_levels = self.trusted.get(\"trust_levels\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"trust_levels\"])\n        for domain, trust in trust_levels.items():\n            if domain in source_url:\n                return int(trust * 30)\n        # 检查是否在可信域列表\n        domains = self.trusted.get(\"domains\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"domains\"])\n        for d in domains:\n            if d in source_url:\n                return 20\n        return 10   # 未知源\n\n    def _score_content_quality(self, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> int:\n        score = 0\n        # 关键点数量\n        score += min(15, len(key_points) * 3)\n        # 文本长度适中\n        length = len(raw_text)\n        if 200 <= length <= 5000:\n            score += 10\n        elif length > 5000:\n            score += 8\n        else:\n            score += 3\n        # 有数字/数据支撑\n        if re.search(r'\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|\\d{4}年|\\d+\\s*(个|种|条|项)', raw_text):\n            score += 5\n        return min(30, score)\n\n    def _score_temporal(self, raw_text: str) -> int:\n        current_year = datetime.datetime.now().year\n        years = re.findall(r'\\b(20\\d{2})\\b', raw_text)\n        if not years:\n            return 10   # 无年份信息，中性\n        max_year = max(int(y) for y in years)\n        age = current_year - max_year\n        if age <= 1:\n            return 20\n        elif age <= 2:\n            return 15\n        elif age <= 3:\n            return 10\n        else:\n            return 5\n\n    # ═══ 内容处理 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _extract_key_points(self, text: str) -> list:\n        \"\"\"提取关键点: 标题、数据事实、结论句\"\"\"\n        points = []\n\n        # 1. 提取数字事实\n        facts = re.findall(\n            r'[^。！？\\n]{5,50}(?:\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|提升\\d+|减少\\d+|增加\\d+|\\d+倍|\\d+个)[^。！？\\n]{0,30}',\n            text\n        )\n        points.extend([f.strip() for f in facts[:3]])\n\n        # 2. 提取结论性句子\n        conclusion_markers = [\"总结\", \"结论\", \"因此\", \"综上\", \"关键在于\", \"核心是\", \"本质上\",\n                               \"In conclusion\", \"Therefore\", \"The key\", \"In summary\"]\n        for marker in conclusion_markers:\n            idx = text.find(marker)\n            if idx != -1:\n                end = text.find(\"。\", idx)\n                if end == -1:\n                    end = idx + 100\n                sentence = text[idx:end+1].strip()\n                if 10 < len(sentence) < 150:\n                    points.append(sentence)\n\n        # 3. 提取首段信息（通常是摘要）\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in text.split(\"\\n\") if len(l.strip()) > 20]\n        if lines:\n            first = lines[0][:120]\n            if first not in points:\n                points.insert(0, first)\n\n        # 去重并限制数量\n        seen = set()\n        unique = []\n        for p in points:\n            key = p[:30]\n            if key not in seen and len(p) > 10:\n                seen.add(key)\n                unique.append(p)\n        return unique[:7]\n\n    def _neutralize(self, text: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"中性化处理: 去除极端词、限制情绪化表达\"\"\"\n        result = text\n        for extreme, neutral in EXTREME_WORDS.items():\n            result = result.replace(extreme, neutral)\n        # 去除连续感叹号\n        result = re.sub(r'！{2,}', '。', result)\n        result = re.sub(r'!{2,}', '.', result)\n        # 去除全大写短语（保留技术术语如API、URL等）\n        result = re.sub(r'\\b([A-Z]{4,})\\b', lambda m: m.group(1) if len(m.group(1)) <= 5 else m.group(1).capitalize(), result)\n        # 截断至合理长度\n        if len(result) > 2000:\n            result = result[:2000] + \"...\"\n        return result.strip()\n\n    def _classify_domain(self, text: str, key_points: str) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"领域分类 + 标签提取\"\"\"\n        combined = text + \" \".join(key_points)\n        scores = {}\n        for domain, signals in DOMAIN_SIGNALS.items():\n            hit = sum(1 for s in signals if s.lower() in combined.lower())\n            if hit > 0:\n                scores[domain] = hit\n        if not scores:\n            return \"general\", [\"知识\", \"通用\"]\n\n        primary = max(scores, key=scores.get)\n        # 提取标签\n        tags = [primary]\n        for domain, count in sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:3]:\n            if domain not in tags:\n                tags.append(domain)\n        # 从文本提取技术标签\n        tech_tags = re.findall(r'\\b(Python|JavaScript|Docker|Kubernetes|React|Vue|Redis|PostgreSQL|MongoDB|FastAPI|LangChain|RAG|MCP|API)\\b', combined)\n        tags.extend(list(set(tech_tags))[:3])\n        return primary, tags[:6]\n\n    def _find_cross_refs(self, key_points: list) -> list:\n        \"\"\"在已有知识库中查找交叉引用\"\"\"\n        refs = []\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return refs\n        try:\n            with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                for line in f:\n                    try:\n                        node = json.loads(line.strip())\n                        node_kp = \" \".join(node.get(\"key_points\", []))\n                        for kp in key_points[:3]:\n                            # 简单词重叠检测\n                            words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', kp))\n                            overlap = sum(1 for w in words if w in node_kp)\n                            if overlap >= 2:\n                                refs.append(node.get(\"dna\", \"unknown\"))\n                                break\n                    except:\n                        continue\n        except:\n            pass\n        return list(set(refs))[:5]\n\n    # ═══ 溯源归属 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _build_attribution(self, source_url: str, chain: DecisionChain) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"构建六点签名链归属块\"\"\"\n        now = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()\n        return {\n            \"source\": source_url or \"direct_input\",\n            \"retrieved_at\": now,\n            \"dna_auth\": chain.step1_dna_auth,\n            \"fuse_passed\": chain.step2_fuse_check,\n            \"collab_verified\": chain.step5_collab_check,\n            \"protocol\": \"知识吸收协议v2.0\",\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫引擎v1.0\",\n            \"note\": \"多维独立验证，不依赖单一来源\"\n        }\n\n    # ═══ 输出格式 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def format_output(self, node: KnowledgeNode) -> str:\n        \"\"\"标准输出格式\"\"\"\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P03雯雯(审计) ⊗ P04文心(语义) · 权重0.40\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} 熔断 — 内容触发安全规则，已拦截\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n        key_pts_str = \"\"\n        for i, kp in enumerate(node.key_points, 1):\n            key_pts_str += f\"  {i}. {kp}\\n\"\n\n        tags_str = \" / \".join(node.tags) if node.tags else \"通用\"\n        cross_str = f\"  交叉引用: {len(node.cross_refs)} 条已有节点\" if node.cross_refs else \"  交叉引用: 暂无匹配\"\n\n        return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P04文心 ⊗ P03雯雯 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 量子纠缠协作\n【四步法】观复 → 知常 → 若水 → 无不为\n{sep}\n【领域】{node.domain}  【标签】{tags_str}\n【权重】{node.weight:.3f}  【审计分】{node.audit_score}/100\n【来源】{node.attribution.get('source', '未知')}\n\n【关键点提取】\n{key_pts_str.rstrip()}\n\n【中性化摘要】\n  {node.neutral_text[:300]}{'...' if len(node.neutral_text) > 300 else ''}\n\n{cross_str}\n{sep}\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} {'通过' if node.audit_color == AuditColor.GREEN else '待审'}\n【归属】{node.attribution.get('protocol')} | {node.attribution.get('engine')}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n    # ═══ 多维推荐引擎 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def recommend(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维推荐: 从知识库独立推导结果，不依赖单一来源\n        维度: 语义相关度 × 权重 × 领域匹配 × 交叉引用密度\n        \"\"\"\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return \"知识库为空，请先使用 --absorb 或 --crawl 录入知识。\"\n\n        nodes = []\n        query_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', query.lower()))\n        _, query_tags = self._classify_domain(query, [])\n\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            for line in f:\n                try:\n                    n = json.loads(line.strip())\n                    nodes.append(n)\n                except:\n                    continue\n\n        # 多维评分\n        scored = []\n        for n in nodes:\n            text = \" \".join(n.get(\"key_points\", [])) + \" \" + n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")\n            node_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', text.lower()))\n\n            # 语义相关度 (词重叠)\n            overlap = len(query_words & node_words)\n            semantic = min(1.0, overlap / max(len(query_words), 1))\n\n            # 领域匹配\n            domain_match = 1.5 if n.get(\"domain\") in query_tags else 1.0\n\n            # 权重加成\n            base_weight = float(n.get(\"weight\", 0.5))\n\n            # 交叉引用密度\n            cross_density = 1.0 + 0.1 * len(n.get(\"cross_refs\", []))\n\n            final_score = semantic * domain_match * base_weight * cross_density\n            if final_score > 0:\n                scored.append((final_score, n))\n\n        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n        top = scored[:top_k]\n\n        if not top:\n            return f\"查询「{query}」暂无匹配知识节点。\"\n\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【多维推荐】查询: {query}\\n【引擎】P04文心 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 独立推导\\n{sep}\\n\\n\"\n\n        for rank, (score, n) in enumerate(top, 1):\n            kps = n.get(\"key_points\", [])\n            kp_str = \"\\n    \".join(kps[:3]) if kps else n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")[:100]\n            out += f\"#{rank}  [{n.get('domain','?')}] 权重{n.get('weight',0):.3f} | 综合评分{score:.3f}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    来源: {n.get('source_url','未知')[:60]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    {kp_str[:200]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    DNA: {n.get('dna','')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"【注】结论由 {len(nodes)} 个知识节点多维交叉推导，不依赖单一来源\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 网页抓取 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def crawl_url(self, url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> str:\n        \"\"\"抓取URL内容，返回纯文本\"\"\"\n        print(f\"  正在抓取: {url}\")\n        try:\n            req = urllib.request.Request(\n                url,\n                headers={\n                    \"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) LonghunCrawler/1.0\",\n                    \"Accept\": \"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*\",\n                    \"Accept-Language\": \"zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8\"\n                }\n            )\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                raw = resp.read()\n                charset = \"utf-8\"\n                ct = resp.headers.get(\"Content-Type\", \"\")\n                m = re.search(r'charset=([^\\s;]+)', ct, re.I)\n                if m:\n                    charset = m.group(1).strip().strip('\"')\n                try:\n                    content = raw.decode(charset, errors=\"replace\")\n                except:\n                    content = raw.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            return f\"[抓取失败: {e}]\"\n\n        # HTML清洗\n        text = self._clean_html(content)\n        return text\n\n    def _clean_html(self, html_content: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"HTML → 纯文本\"\"\"\n        # 去脚本/样式\n        text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', html_content, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        # 提取主要文本区域\n        main_match = re.search(r'<(?:article|main|div[^>]*(?:content|main|article)[^>]*)>(.*?)</(?:article|main|div)>',\n                                text, re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        if main_match:\n            text = main_match.group(1)\n        # 去标签\n        text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)\n        # 解码HTML实体\n        text = html.unescape(text)\n        # 清理空白\n        text = re.sub(r'\\s{3,}', '\\n\\n', text)\n        text = text.strip()\n        return text[:8000]\n\n    # ═══ 技能索引管理 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _update_skill_index(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"更新技能索引\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        domain = node.domain\n        if domain not in self.skill_index[\"domains\"]:\n            self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain] = []\n\n        entry = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:80] if node.source_url else \"direct\"\n        }\n        self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain].append(entry)\n\n        # 标签索引\n        for tag in node.tags:\n            if tag not in self.skill_index[\"tags\"]:\n                self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag] = []\n            self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag].append(node.dna)\n\n        # Top权重列表（保持前20）\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"].append({\"dna\": node.dna, \"weight\": node.weight, \"domain\": domain})\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"] = sorted(\n            self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"], key=lambda x: -x[\"weight\"]\n        )[:20]\n\n        # 元信息\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"last_updated\"] = node.timestamp\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"total_nodes\"] = self.skill_index[\"_meta\"].get(\"total_nodes\", 0) + 1\n\n        with open(SKILL_INDEX, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(self.skill_index, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n    def show_index(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"显示技能索引概览\"\"\"\n        meta = self.skill_index.get(\"_meta\", {})\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【技能索引】龍魂知识库概览\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        out += f\"总节点数: {meta.get('total_nodes', 0)}\\n\"\n        out += f\"最后更新: {meta.get('last_updated', '未知')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += \"【领域分布】\\n\"\n        domains = self.skill_index.get(\"domains\", {})\n        for domain, entries in domains.items():\n            if entries:\n                avg_weight = sum(e.get(\"weight\", 0) for e in entries) / len(entries)\n                out += f\"  {domain:15s}: {len(entries):3d} 节点 | 平均权重 {avg_weight:.3f}\\n\"\n\n        top = self.skill_index.get(\"weight_top\", [])[:10]\n        if top:\n            out += \"\\n【高权重节点 Top10】\\n\"\n            for i, t in enumerate(top, 1):\n                out += f\"  {i:2d}. [{t['domain']:10s}] {t['weight']:.3f} | {t['dna']}\\n\"\n\n        tags = self.skill_index.get(\"tags\", {})\n        if tags:\n            out += f\"\\n【活跃标签 Top10】\\n\"\n            top_tags = sorted(tags.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))[:10]\n            for tag, dnas in top_tags:\n                out += f\"  {tag}: {len(dnas)} 节点\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 持久化 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _write_knowledge_db(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入knowledge-db.jsonl\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        record = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source_url\": node.source_url,\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit_score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"key_points\": node.key_points,\n            \"neutral_text\": node.neutral_text[:500],\n            \"cross_refs\": node.cross_refs,\n            \"attribution\": node.attribution\n        }\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n    def _append_memory(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入memory.jsonl（TIER_2 append-only）\"\"\"\n        record = {\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"event\": \"knowledge_absorbed\",\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit\": node.audit_color.value,\n            \"score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"tags\": node.tags[:3],\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:100] if node.source_url else \"direct\",\n            \"key_points_count\": len(node.key_points),\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫v1.0\"\n        }\n        with open(MEMORY_FILE, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n    def _bridge_to_star_memory(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"写入star_memory vault\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        if not node.key_points:\n            return\n\n        # 生成STAR ID\n        date_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        existing = list((STAR_VAULT / \"vault\").glob(f\"STAR-{date_str}-*.json\"))\n        idx = len(existing) + 1\n        star_id = f\"STAR-{date_str}-{idx:03d}\"\n\n        content = {\n            \"id\": star_id,\n            \"title\": f\"[{node.domain}] {node.key_points[0][:60] if node.key_points else '知识节点'}\",\n            \"content\": node.neutral_text[:800],\n            \"key_points\": node.key_points,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"source\": node.source_url or \"direct_input\",\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"dna_chain\": {\n                \"content_dna\": node.dna,\n                \"operation_dna\": self._gen_dna(\"STAR-WRITE\"),\n                \"version_dna\": f\"#STAR⚡️{date_str}-{star_id}-v1.0\"\n            },\n            \"longhun_bridge\": {\n                \"memory_ref\": node.dna,\n                \"audit_color\": node.audit_color.value,\n                \"audit_score\": node.audit_score,\n                \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫v1.0\"\n            },\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp\n        }\n\n        star_file = STAR_VAULT / \"vault\" / f\"{star_id}.json\"\n        with open(star_file, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(content, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n    def _read_recent_memory(self, n: int = 5) -> list:\n        \"\"\"读取最近n条memory记录（吸气）\"\"\"\n        if not MEMORY_FILE.exists():\n            return []\n        records = []\n        with open(MEMORY_FILE, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            for line in f:\n                try:\n                    records.append(json.loads(line.strip()))\n                except:\n                    continue\n        return records[-n:]\n\n    def _log_crawler(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"写入爬虫专用日志\"\"\"\n        record = {\n            \"ts\":   \"\"\"\n        ctx  = self.inhale(source_url=source_url, raw_text=raw_text)\n        node = self.process(ctx)\n        out  = self.exhale(node)\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 六步决策树 ══════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _run_decision_tree(self, raw_text: str, source_url: str) -> DecisionChain:\n        chain = DecisionChain()\n\n        # Step 1: DNA身份认证（系统内部 → 自动通过）\n        chain.step1_dna_auth = True\n\n        # Step 2: 熔断检测\n        fuse_kw = self.trusted.get(\"fuse_keywords\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"fuse_keywords\"])\n        suspicious = self.trusted.get(\"suspicious_patterns\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"suspicious_patterns\"])\n        text_lower = raw_text.lower()\n        triggered = any(kw in raw_text for kw in fuse_kw)\n        triggered = triggered or any(p in raw_text for p in suspicious)\n        chain.step2_fuse_check = not triggered   # True = 通过（无熔断词）\n\n        # Step 3: 溯源归属\n        chain.step3_source_attr = source_url or \"direct_input\"\n\n        # Step 4: 信息加工（本方法外处理，此处标记完成）\n        chain.step4_info_process = True\n\n        # Step 5: 协作校验（P03⊗P04⊗P08量子纠缠态）\n        chain.step5_collab_check = True\n\n        return chain\n\n    def _hash_chain(self, chain: DecisionChain) -> str:\n        data = f\"{chain.step1_dna_auth}{chain.step2_fuse_check}{chain.step3_source_attr}{chain.step4_info_process}{chain.step5_collab_check}{chain.step6_output_sign}\"\n        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n    # ═══ 多维权重计算 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _calculate_weight(self, source_url: str, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维权重: 源可信度(30) + 内容质量(30) + 交叉验证(20) + 时效性(20)\n        返回: (weight_0_to_1, audit_score_0_to_100)\n        \"\"\"\n        score = 0\n\n        # 维度1: 源可信度 (0-30)\n        src_score = self._score_source(source_url)\n        score += src_score\n\n        # 维度2: 内容质量 (0-30)\n        quality = self._score_content_quality(raw_text, key_points)\n        score += quality\n\n        # 维度3: 交叉验证 (0-20) — 与已有知识节点的关联度\n        cross_score = min(20, len(self._find_cross_refs(key_points)) * 4)\n        score += cross_score\n\n        # 维度4: 时效性 (0-20) — 文本中含年份信息加分\n        temporal = self._score_temporal(raw_text)\n        score += temporal\n\n        weight = round(score / 100.0, 3)\n        return weight, score\n\n    def _score_source(self, source_url: str) -> int:\n        if not source_url or source_url == \"direct_input\":\n            return 22   # 直接输入，用户自提供，可信度较高\n        trust_levels = self.trusted.get(\"trust_levels\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"trust_levels\"])\n        for domain, trust in trust_levels.items():\n            if domain in source_url:\n                return int(trust * 30)\n        # 检查是否在可信域列表\n        domains = self.trusted.get(\"domains\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"domains\"])\n        for d in domains:\n            if d in source_url:\n                return 20\n        return 10   # 未知源\n\n    def _score_content_quality(self, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> int:\n        score = 0\n        # 关键点数量\n        score += min(15, len(key_points) * 3)\n        # 文本长度适中\n        length = len(raw_text)\n        if 200 <= length <= 5000:\n            score += 10\n        elif length > 5000:\n            score += 8\n        else:\n            score += 3\n        # 有数字/数据支撑\n        if re.search(r'\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|\\d{4}年|\\d+\\s*(个|种|条|项)', raw_text):\n            score += 5\n        return min(30, score)\n\n    def _score_temporal(self, raw_text: str) -> int:\n        current_year = datetime.datetime.now().year\n        years = re.findall(r'\\b(20\\d{2})\\b', raw_text)\n        if not years:\n            return 10   # 无年份信息，中性\n        max_year = max(int(y) for y in years)\n        age = current_year - max_year\n        if age <= 1:\n            return 20\n        elif age <= 2:\n            return 15\n        elif age <= 3:\n            return 10\n        else:\n            return 5\n\n    # ═══ 内容处理 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _extract_key_points(self, text: str) -> list:\n        \"\"\"提取关键点: 标题、数据事实、结论句\"\"\"\n        points = []\n\n        # 1. 提取数字事实\n        facts = re.findall(\n            r'[^。！？\\n]{5,50}(?:\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|提升\\d+|减少\\d+|增加\\d+|\\d+倍|\\d+个)[^。！？\\n]{0,30}',\n            text\n        )\n        points.extend([f.strip() for f in facts[:3]])\n\n        # 2. 提取结论性句子\n        conclusion_markers = [\"总结\", \"结论\", \"因此\", \"综上\", \"关键在于\", \"核心是\", \"本质上\",\n                               \"In conclusion\", \"Therefore\", \"The key\", \"In summary\"]\n        for marker in conclusion_markers:\n            idx = text.find(marker)\n            if idx != -1:\n                end = text.find(\"。\", idx)\n                if end == -1:\n                    end = idx + 100\n                sentence = text[idx:end+1].strip()\n                if 10 < len(sentence) < 150:\n                    points.append(sentence)\n\n        # 3. 提取首段信息（通常是摘要）\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in text.split(\"\\n\") if len(l.strip()) > 20]\n        if lines:\n            first = lines[0][:120]\n            if first not in points:\n                points.insert(0, first)\n\n        # 去重并限制数量\n        seen = set()\n        unique = []\n        for p in points:\n            key = p[:30]\n            if key not in seen and len(p) > 10:\n                seen.add(key)\n                unique.append(p)\n        return unique[:7]\n\n    def _neutralize(self, text: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"中性化处理: 去除极端词、限制情绪化表达\"\"\"\n        result = text\n        for extreme, neutral in EXTREME_WORDS.items():\n            result = result.replace(extreme, neutral)\n        # 去除连续感叹号\n        result = re.sub(r'！{2,}', '。', result)\n        result = re.sub(r'!{2,}', '.', result)\n        # 去除全大写短语（保留技术术语如API、URL等）\n        result = re.sub(r'\\b([A-Z]{4,})\\b', lambda m: m.group(1) if len(m.group(1)) <= 5 else m.group(1).capitalize(), result)\n        # 截断至合理长度\n        if len(result) > 2000:\n            result = result[:2000] + \"...\"\n        return result.strip()\n\n    def _classify_domain(self, text: str, key_points: str) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"领域分类 + 标签提取\"\"\"\n        combined = text + \" \".join(key_points)\n        scores = {}\n        for domain, signals in DOMAIN_SIGNALS.items():\n            hit = sum(1 for s in signals if s.lower() in combined.lower())\n            if hit > 0:\n                scores[domain] = hit\n        if not scores:\n            return \"general\", [\"知识\", \"通用\"]\n\n        primary = max(scores, key=scores.get)\n        # 提取标签\n        tags = [primary]\n        for domain, count in sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:3]:\n            if domain not in tags:\n                tags.append(domain)\n        # 从文本提取技术标签\n        tech_tags = re.findall(r'\\b(Python|JavaScript|Docker|Kubernetes|React|Vue|Redis|PostgreSQL|MongoDB|FastAPI|LangChain|RAG|MCP|API)\\b', combined)\n        tags.extend(list(set(tech_tags))[:3])\n        return primary, tags[:6]\n\n    def _find_cross_refs(self, key_points: list) -> list:\n        \"\"\"在已有知识库中查找交叉引用\"\"\"\n        refs = []\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return refs\n        try:\n            with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                for line in f:\n                    try:\n                        node = json.loads(line.strip())\n                        node_kp = \" \".join(node.get(\"key_points\", []))\n                        for kp in key_points[:3]:\n                            # 简单词重叠检测\n                            words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', kp))\n                            overlap = sum(1 for w in words if w in node_kp)\n                            if overlap >= 2:\n                                refs.append(node.get(\"dna\", \"unknown\"))\n                                break\n                    except:\n                        continue\n        except:\n            pass\n        return list(set(refs))[:5]\n\n    # ═══ 溯源归属 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _build_attribution(self, source_url: str, chain: DecisionChain) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"构建六点签名链归属块\"\"\"\n        now = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()\n        return {\n            \"source\": source_url or \"direct_input\",\n            \"retrieved_at\": now,\n            \"dna_auth\": chain.step1_dna_auth,\n            \"fuse_passed\": chain.step2_fuse_check,\n            \"collab_verified\": chain.step5_collab_check,\n            \"protocol\": \"知识吸收协议v2.0\",\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫引擎v1.0\",\n            \"note\": \"多维独立验证，不依赖单一来源\"\n        }\n\n    # ═══ 输出格式 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def format_output(self, node: KnowledgeNode) -> str:\n        \"\"\"标准输出格式\"\"\"\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P03雯雯(审计) ⊗ P04文心(语义) · 权重0.40\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} 熔断 — 内容触发安全规则，已拦截\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n        key_pts_str = \"\"\n        for i, kp in enumerate(node.key_points, 1):\n            key_pts_str += f\"  {i}. {kp}\\n\"\n\n        tags_str = \" / \".join(node.tags) if node.tags else \"通用\"\n        cross_str = f\"  交叉引用: {len(node.cross_refs)} 条已有节点\" if node.cross_refs else \"  交叉引用: 暂无匹配\"\n\n        return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P04文心 ⊗ P03雯雯 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 量子纠缠协作\n【四步法】观复 → 知常 → 若水 → 无不为\n{sep}\n【领域】{node.domain}  【标签】{tags_str}\n【权重】{node.weight:.3f}  【审计分】{node.audit_score}/100\n【来源】{node.attribution.get('source', '未知')}\n\n【关键点提取】\n{key_pts_str.rstrip()}\n\n【中性化摘要】\n  {node.neutral_text[:300]}{'...' if len(node.neutral_text) > 300 else ''}\n\n{cross_str}\n{sep}\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} {'通过' if node.audit_color == AuditColor.GREEN else '待审'}\n【归属】{node.attribution.get('protocol')} | {node.attribution.get('engine')}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n    # ═══ 多维推荐引擎 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def recommend(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维推荐: 从知识库独立推导结果，不依赖单一来源\n        维度: 语义相关度 × 权重 × 领域匹配 × 交叉引用密度\n        \"\"\"\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return \"知识库为空，请先使用 --absorb 或 --crawl 录入知识。\"\n\n        nodes = []\n        query_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', query.lower()))\n        _, query_tags = self._classify_domain(query, [])\n\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            for line in f:\n                try:\n                    n = json.loads(line.strip())\n                    nodes.append(n)\n                except:\n                    continue\n\n        # 多维评分\n        scored = []\n        for n in nodes:\n            text = \" \".join(n.get(\"key_points\", [])) + \" \" + n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")\n            node_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', text.lower()))\n\n            # 语义相关度 (词重叠)\n            overlap = len(query_words & node_words)\n            semantic = min(1.0, overlap / max(len(query_words), 1))\n\n            # 领域匹配\n            domain_match = 1.5 if n.get(\"domain\") in query_tags else 1.0\n\n            # 权重加成\n            base_weight = float(n.get(\"weight\", 0.5))\n\n            # 交叉引用密度\n            cross_density = 1.0 + 0.1 * len(n.get(\"cross_refs\", []))\n\n            final_score = semantic * domain_match * base_weight * cross_density\n            if final_score > 0:\n                scored.append((final_score, n))\n\n        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n        top = scored[:top_k]\n\n        if not top:\n            return f\"查询「{query}」暂无匹配知识节点。\"\n\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【多维推荐】查询: {query}\\n【引擎】P04文心 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 独立推导\\n{sep}\\n\\n\"\n\n        for rank, (score, n) in enumerate(top, 1):\n            kps = n.get(\"key_points\", [])\n            kp_str = \"\\n    \".join(kps[:3]) if kps else n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")[:100]\n            out += f\"#{rank}  [{n.get('domain','?')}] 权重{n.get('weight',0):.3f} | 综合评分{score:.3f}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    来源: {n.get('source_url','未知')[:60]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    {kp_str[:200]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    DNA: {n.get('dna','')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"【注】结论由 {len(nodes)} 个知识节点多维交叉推导，不依赖单一来源\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 网页抓取 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def crawl_url(self, url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> str:\n        \"\"\"抓取URL内容，返回纯文本\"\"\"\n        print(f\"  正在抓取: {url}\")\n        try:\n            req = urllib.request.Request(\n                url,\n                headers={\n                    \"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) LonghunCrawler/1.0\",\n                    \"Accept\": \"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*\",\n                    \"Accept-Language\": \"zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8\"\n                }\n            )\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                raw = resp.read()\n                charset = \"utf-8\"\n                ct = resp.headers.get(\"Content-Type\", \"\")\n                m = re.search(r'charset=([^\\s;]+)', ct, re.I)\n                if m:\n                    charset = m.group(1).strip().strip('\"')\n                try:\n                    content = raw.decode(charset, errors=\"replace\")\n                except:\n                    content = raw.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            return f\"[抓取失败: {e}]\"\n\n        # HTML清洗\n        text = self._clean_html(content)\n        return text\n\n    def _clean_html(self, html_content: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"HTML → 纯文本\"\"\"\n        # 去脚本/样式\n        text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', html_content, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        # 提取主要文本区域\n        main_match = re.search(r'<(?:article|main|div[^>]*(?:content|main|article)[^>]*)>(.*?)</(?:article|main|div)>',\n                                text, re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        if main_match:\n            text = main_match.group(1)\n        # 去标签\n        text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)\n        # 解码HTML实体\n        text = html.unescape(text)\n        # 清理空白\n        text = re.sub(r'\\s{3,}', '\\n\\n', text)\n        text = text.strip()\n        return text[:8000]\n\n    # ═══ 技能索引管理 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _update_skill_index(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"更新技能索引\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        domain = node.domain\n        if domain not in self.skill_index[\"domains\"]:\n            self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain] = []\n\n        entry = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:80] if node.source_url else \"direct\"\n        }\n        self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain].append(entry)\n\n        # 标签索引\n        for tag in node.tags:\n            if tag not in self.skill_index[\"tags\"]:\n                self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag] = []\n            self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag].append(node.dna)\n\n        # Top权重列表（保持前20）\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"].append({\"dna\": node.dna, \"weight\": node.weight, \"domain\": domain})\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"] = sorted(\n            self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"], key=lambda x: -x[\"weight\"]\n        )[:20]\n\n        # 元信息\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"last_updated\"] = node.timestamp\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"total_nodes\"] = self.skill_index[\"_meta\"].get(\"total_nodes\", 0) + 1\n\n        with open(SKILL_INDEX, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(self.skill_index, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n    def show_index(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"显示技能索引概览\"\"\"\n        meta = self.skill_index.get(\"_meta\", {})\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【技能索引】龍魂知识库概览\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        out += f\"总节点数: {meta.get('total_nodes', 0)}\\n\"\n        out += f\"最后更新: {meta.get('last_updated', '未知')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += \"【领域分布】\\n\"\n        domains = self.skill_index.get(\"domains\", {})\n        for domain, entries in domains.items():\n            if entries:\n                avg_weight = sum(e.get(\"weight\", 0) for e in entries) / len(entries)\n                out += f\"  {domain:15s}: {len(entries):3d} 节点 | 平均权重 {avg_weight:.3f}\\n\"\n\n        top = self.skill_index.get(\"weight_top\", [])[:10]\n        if top:\n            out += \"\\n【高权重节点 Top10】\\n\"\n            for i, t in enumerate(top, 1):\n                out += f\"  {i:2d}. [{t['domain']:10s}] {t['weight']:.3f} | {t['dna']}\\n\"\n\n        tags = self.skill_index.get(\"tags\", {})\n        if tags:\n            out += f\"\\n【活跃标签 Top10】\\n\"\n            top_tags = sorted(tags.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))[:10]\n            for tag, dnas in top_tags:\n                out += f\"  {tag}: {len(dnas)} 节点\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 持久化 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _write_knowledge_db(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入knowledge-db.jsonl\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        record = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source_url\": node.source_url,\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit_score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"key_points\": node.key_points,\n            \"neutral_text\": node.neutral_text[:500],\n            \"cross_refs\": node.cross_refs,\n            \"attribution\": node.attribution\n        }\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n    def _append_memory(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入memory.jsonl（TIER_2 append-only）\"\"\"\n        record = {\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"event\": \"knowledge_absorbed\",\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit\": node.audit_color.value,\n            \"score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"tags\": node.tags[:3],\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:100] if node.source_url else \"direct\",\n            \"key_points_count\": len(node.key_points),\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫v1.0\"\n        }\n        with open(MEMORY_FILE, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n    def _bridge_to_star_memory(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"写入star_memory vault\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        if not node.key_points:\n            return\n\n        # 生成STAR ID\n        date_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        existing = list((STAR_VAULT / \"vault\").glob(f\"STAR-{date_str}-*.json\"))\n        idx = len(existing) + 1\n        star_id = f\"STAR-{date_str}-{idx:03d}\"\n\n        content = {\n            \"id\": star_id,\n            \"title\": f\"[{node.domain}] {node.key_points[0][:60] if node.key_points else '知识节点'}\",\n            \"content\": node.neutral_text[:800],\n            \"key_points\": node.key_points,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"source\": node.source_url or \"direct_input\",\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"dna_chain\": {\n                \"content_dna\": node.dna,\n                \"operation_dna\": KnowledgeNode(\n            source_url=source_url,\n            raw_text=raw_text[:500],\n            key_points=key_points,\n            tags=tags,\n            domain=domain,\n            weight=weight,\n            audit_color=color,\n            audit_score=score,\n            dna=dna,\n            timestamp=timestamp,\n            neutral_text=neutral,\n            attribution=attribution,\n            cross_refs=self._find_cross_refs(key_points)\n        )\n        return node\n\n    def exhale(self, node: KnowledgeNode) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        呼气: 输出标准格式 + 写入knowledge-db + 更新skill-index + 追加memory.jsonl\n        \"\"\"\n        output = self.format_output(node)\n\n        # 写入知识库\n        self._write_knowledge_db(node)\n\n        # 更新技能索引\n        self._update_skill_index(node)\n\n        # 追加memory.jsonl\n        self._append_memory(node)\n\n        # 可选: 写入star_memory\n        self._bridge_to_star_memory(node)\n\n        # 写入爬虫日志\n        self._log_crawler(node)\n\n        return output\n\n    def breathe(self, source_url: str = \"\", raw_text: str = \"\") -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        完整呼吸周期: inhale → process → exhale → loop\n        \"\"\"\n        ctx  = self.inhale(source_url=source_url, raw_text=raw_text)\n        node = self.process(ctx)\n        out  = self.exhale(node)\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 六步决策树 ══════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _run_decision_tree(self, raw_text: str, source_url: str) -> DecisionChain:\n        chain = DecisionChain()\n\n        # Step 1: DNA身份认证（系统内部 → 自动通过）\n        chain.step1_dna_auth = True\n\n        # Step 2: 熔断检测\n        fuse_kw = self.trusted.get(\"fuse_keywords\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"fuse_keywords\"])\n        suspicious = self.trusted.get(\"suspicious_patterns\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"suspicious_patterns\"])\n        text_lower = raw_text.lower()\n        triggered = any(kw in raw_text for kw in fuse_kw)\n        triggered = triggered or any(p in raw_text for p in suspicious)\n        chain.step2_fuse_check = not triggered   # True = 通过（无熔断词）\n\n        # Step 3: 溯源归属\n        chain.step3_source_attr = source_url or \"direct_input\"\n\n        # Step 4: 信息加工（本方法外处理，此处标记完成）\n        chain.step4_info_process = True\n\n        # Step 5: 协作校验（P03⊗P04⊗P08量子纠缠态）\n        chain.step5_collab_check = True\n\n        return chain\n\n    def _hash_chain(self, chain: DecisionChain) -> str:\n        data = f\"{chain.step1_dna_auth}{chain.step2_fuse_check}{chain.step3_source_attr}{chain.step4_info_process}{chain.step5_collab_check}{chain.step6_output_sign}\"\n        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n    # ═══ 多维权重计算 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _calculate_weight(self, source_url: str, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维权重: 源可信度(30) + 内容质量(30) + 交叉验证(20) + 时效性(20)\n        返回: (weight_0_to_1, audit_score_0_to_100)\n        \"\"\"\n        score = 0\n\n        # 维度1: 源可信度 (0-30)\n        src_score = self._score_source(source_url)\n        score += src_score\n\n        # 维度2: 内容质量 (0-30)\n        quality = self._score_content_quality(raw_text, key_points)\n        score += quality\n\n        # 维度3: 交叉验证 (0-20) — 与已有知识节点的关联度\n        cross_score = min(20, len(self._find_cross_refs(key_points)) * 4)\n        score += cross_score\n\n        # 维度4: 时效性 (0-20) — 文本中含年份信息加分\n        temporal = self._score_temporal(raw_text)\n        score += temporal\n\n        weight = round(score / 100.0, 3)\n        return weight, score\n\n    def _score_source(self, source_url: str) -> int:\n        if not source_url or source_url == \"direct_input\":\n            return 22   # 直接输入，用户自提供，可信度较高\n        trust_levels = self.trusted.get(\"trust_levels\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"trust_levels\"])\n        for domain, trust in trust_levels.items():\n            if domain in source_url:\n                return int(trust * 30)\n        # 检查是否在可信域列表\n        domains = self.trusted.get(\"domains\", DEFAULT_TRUSTED_SOURCES[\"domains\"])\n        for d in domains:\n            if d in source_url:\n                return 20\n        return 10   # 未知源\n\n    def _score_content_quality(self, raw_text: str, key_points: list) -> int:\n        score = 0\n        # 关键点数量\n        score += min(15, len(key_points) * 3)\n        # 文本长度适中\n        length = len(raw_text)\n        if 200 <= length <= 5000:\n            score += 10\n        elif length > 5000:\n            score += 8\n        else:\n            score += 7   # 短文本不惩罚，仍给基础分\n        # 有数字/数据支撑\n        if re.search(r'\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|\\d{4}年|\\d+\\s*(个|种|条|项)', raw_text):\n            score += 5\n        return min(30, score)\n\n    def _score_temporal(self, raw_text: str) -> int:\n        current_year = datetime.datetime.now().year\n        years = re.findall(r'\\b(20\\d{2})\\b', raw_text)\n        if not years:\n            return 10   # 无年份信息，中性\n        max_year = max(int(y) for y in years)\n        age = current_year - max_year\n        if age <= 1:\n            return 20\n        elif age <= 2:\n            return 15\n        elif age <= 3:\n            return 10\n        else:\n            return 5\n\n    # ═══ 内容处理 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _extract_key_points(self, text: str) -> list:\n        \"\"\"提取关键点: 标题、数据事实、结论句\"\"\"\n        points = []\n\n        # 1. 提取数字事实\n        facts = re.findall(\n            r'[^。！？\\n]{5,50}(?:\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*[%％]|提升\\d+|减少\\d+|增加\\d+|\\d+倍|\\d+个)[^。！？\\n]{0,30}',\n            text\n        )\n        points.extend([f.strip() for f in facts[:3]])\n\n        # 2. 提取结论性句子\n        conclusion_markers = [\"总结\", \"结论\", \"因此\", \"综上\", \"关键在于\", \"核心是\", \"本质上\",\n                               \"In conclusion\", \"Therefore\", \"The key\", \"In summary\"]\n        for marker in conclusion_markers:\n            idx = text.find(marker)\n            if idx != -1:\n                end = text.find(\"。\", idx)\n                if end == -1:\n                    end = idx + 100\n                sentence = text[idx:end+1].strip()\n                if 10 < len(sentence) < 150:\n                    points.append(sentence)\n\n        # 3. 提取首段信息（通常是摘要）\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in text.split(\"\\n\") if len(l.strip()) > 20]\n        if lines:\n            first = lines[0][:120]\n            if first not in points:\n                points.insert(0, first)\n\n        # 去重并限制数量\n        seen = set()\n        unique = []\n        for p in points:\n            key = p[:30]\n            if key not in seen and len(p) > 10:\n                seen.add(key)\n                unique.append(p)\n        return unique[:7]\n\n    def _neutralize(self, text: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"中性化处理: 去除极端词、限制情绪化表达\"\"\"\n        result = text\n        for extreme, neutral in EXTREME_WORDS.items():\n            result = result.replace(extreme, neutral)\n        # 去除连续感叹号\n        result = re.sub(r'！{2,}', '。', result)\n        result = re.sub(r'!{2,}', '.', result)\n        # 去除全大写短语（保留技术术语如API、URL等）\n        result = re.sub(r'\\b([A-Z]{4,})\\b', lambda m: m.group(1) if len(m.group(1)) <= 5 else m.group(1).capitalize(), result)\n        # 截断至合理长度\n        if len(result) > 2000:\n            result = result[:2000] + \"...\"\n        return result.strip()\n\n    def _classify_domain(self, text: str, key_points: str) -> tuple:\n        \"\"\"领域分类 + 标签提取\"\"\"\n        combined = text + \" \".join(key_points)\n        scores = {}\n        for domain, signals in DOMAIN_SIGNALS.items():\n            hit = sum(1 for s in signals if s.lower() in combined.lower())\n            if hit > 0:\n                scores[domain] = hit\n        if not scores:\n            return \"general\", [\"知识\", \"通用\"]\n\n        primary = max(scores, key=scores.get)\n        # 提取标签\n        tags = [primary]\n        for domain, count in sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:3]:\n            if domain not in tags:\n                tags.append(domain)\n        # 从文本提取技术标签\n        tech_tags = re.findall(r'\\b(Python|JavaScript|Docker|Kubernetes|React|Vue|Redis|PostgreSQL|MongoDB|FastAPI|LangChain|RAG|MCP|API)\\b', combined)\n        tags.extend(list(set(tech_tags))[:3])\n        return primary, tags[:6]\n\n    def _find_cross_refs(self, key_points: list) -> list:\n        \"\"\"在已有知识库中查找交叉引用\"\"\"\n        refs = []\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return refs\n        try:\n            with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                for line in f:\n                    try:\n                        node = json.loads(line.strip())\n                        node_kp = \" \".join(node.get(\"key_points\", []))\n                        for kp in key_points[:3]:\n                            # 简单词重叠检测\n                            words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', kp))\n                            overlap = sum(1 for w in words if w in node_kp)\n                            if overlap >= 2:\n                                refs.append(node.get(\"dna\", \"unknown\"))\n                                break\n                    except:\n                        continue\n        except:\n            pass\n        return list(set(refs))[:5]\n\n    # ═══ 溯源归属 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _build_attribution(self, source_url: str, chain: DecisionChain) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"构建六点签名链归属块\"\"\"\n        now = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()\n        return {\n            \"source\": source_url or \"direct_input\",\n            \"retrieved_at\": now,\n            \"dna_auth\": chain.step1_dna_auth,\n            \"fuse_passed\": chain.step2_fuse_check,\n            \"collab_verified\": chain.step5_collab_check,\n            \"protocol\": \"知识吸收协议v2.0\",\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫引擎v1.0\",\n            \"note\": \"多维独立验证，不依赖单一来源\"\n        }\n\n    # ═══ 输出格式 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def format_output(self, node: KnowledgeNode) -> str:\n        \"\"\"标准输出格式\"\"\"\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P03雯雯(审计) ⊗ P04文心(语义) · 权重0.40\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} 熔断 — 内容触发安全规则，已拦截\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n        key_pts_str = \"\"\n        for i, kp in enumerate(node.key_points, 1):\n            key_pts_str += f\"  {i}. {kp}\\n\"\n\n        tags_str = \" / \".join(node.tags) if node.tags else \"通用\"\n        cross_str = f\"  交叉引用: {len(node.cross_refs)} 条已有节点\" if node.cross_refs else \"  交叉引用: 暂无匹配\"\n\n        return f\"\"\"\n{sep}\n【人格路由】☵坎 P04文心 ⊗ P03雯雯 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 量子纠缠协作\n【四步法】观复 → 知常 → 若水 → 无不为\n{sep}\n【领域】{node.domain}  【标签】{tags_str}\n【权重】{node.weight:.3f}  【审计分】{node.audit_score}/100\n【来源】{node.attribution.get('source', '未知')}\n\n【关键点提取】\n{key_pts_str.rstrip()}\n\n【中性化摘要】\n  {node.neutral_text[:300]}{'...' if len(node.neutral_text) > 300 else ''}\n\n{cross_str}\n{sep}\n【DNA】{node.dna}\n【三色】{node.audit_color.value} {'通过' if node.audit_color == AuditColor.GREEN else '待审'}\n【归属】{node.attribution.get('protocol')} | {node.attribution.get('engine')}\n{sep}\n\"\"\"\n\n    # ═══ 多维推荐引擎 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def recommend(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        多维推荐: 从知识库独立推导结果，不依赖单一来源\n        维度: 语义相关度 × 权重 × 领域匹配 × 交叉引用密度\n        \"\"\"\n        if not KNOWLEDGE_DB.exists():\n            return \"知识库为空，请先使用 --absorb 或 --crawl 录入知识。\"\n\n        nodes = []\n        query_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', query.lower()))\n        _, query_tags = self._classify_domain(query, [])\n\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            for line in f:\n                try:\n                    n = json.loads(line.strip())\n                    nodes.append(n)\n                except:\n                    continue\n\n        # 多维评分\n        scored = []\n        for n in nodes:\n            text = \" \".join(n.get(\"key_points\", [])) + \" \" + n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")\n            node_words = set(re.findall(r'[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]{4,}', text.lower()))\n\n            # 语义相关度 (词重叠)\n            overlap = len(query_words & node_words)\n            semantic = min(1.0, overlap / max(len(query_words), 1))\n\n            # 领域匹配\n            domain_match = 1.5 if n.get(\"domain\") in query_tags else 1.0\n\n            # 权重加成\n            base_weight = float(n.get(\"weight\", 0.5))\n\n            # 交叉引用密度\n            cross_density = 1.0 + 0.1 * len(n.get(\"cross_refs\", []))\n\n            final_score = semantic * domain_match * base_weight * cross_density\n            if final_score > 0:\n                scored.append((final_score, n))\n\n        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n        top = scored[:top_k]\n\n        if not top:\n            return f\"查询「{query}」暂无匹配知识节点。\"\n\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【多维推荐】查询: {query}\\n【引擎】P04文心 ⊗ P08数据大师 · 独立推导\\n{sep}\\n\\n\"\n\n        for rank, (score, n) in enumerate(top, 1):\n            kps = n.get(\"key_points\", [])\n            kp_str = \"\\n    \".join(kps[:3]) if kps else n.get(\"neutral_text\", \"\")[:100]\n            out += f\"#{rank}  [{n.get('domain','?')}] 权重{n.get('weight',0):.3f} | 综合评分{score:.3f}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    来源: {n.get('source_url','未知')[:60]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    {kp_str[:200]}\\n\"\n            out += f\"    DNA: {n.get('dna','')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"【注】结论由 {len(nodes)} 个知识节点多维交叉推导，不依赖单一来源\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 网页抓取 ════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def crawl_url(self, url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> str:\n        \"\"\"抓取URL内容，返回纯文本\"\"\"\n        print(f\"  正在抓取: {url}\")\n        try:\n            req = urllib.request.Request(\n                url,\n                headers={\n                    \"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) LonghunCrawler/1.0\",\n                    \"Accept\": \"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*\",\n                    \"Accept-Language\": \"zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8\"\n                }\n            )\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                raw = resp.read()\n                charset = \"utf-8\"\n                ct = resp.headers.get(\"Content-Type\", \"\")\n                m = re.search(r'charset=([^\\s;]+)', ct, re.I)\n                if m:\n                    charset = m.group(1).strip().strip('\"')\n                try:\n                    content = raw.decode(charset, errors=\"replace\")\n                except:\n                    content = raw.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            return f\"[抓取失败: {e}]\"\n\n        # HTML清洗\n        text = self._clean_html(content)\n        return text\n\n    def _clean_html(self, html_content: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"HTML → 纯文本\"\"\"\n        # 去脚本/样式\n        text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', html_content, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        # 提取主要文本区域\n        main_match = re.search(r'<(?:article|main|div[^>]*(?:content|main|article)[^>]*)>(.*?)</(?:article|main|div)>',\n                                text, re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n        if main_match:\n            text = main_match.group(1)\n        # 去标签\n        text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)\n        # 解码HTML实体\n        text = html.unescape(text)\n        # 清理空白\n        text = re.sub(r'\\s{3,}', '\\n\\n', text)\n        text = text.strip()\n        return text[:8000]\n\n    # ═══ 技能索引管理 ════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _update_skill_index(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"更新技能索引\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        domain = node.domain\n        if domain not in self.skill_index[\"domains\"]:\n            self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain] = []\n\n        entry = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:80] if node.source_url else \"direct\"\n        }\n        self.skill_index[\"domains\"][domain].append(entry)\n\n        # 标签索引\n        for tag in node.tags:\n            if tag not in self.skill_index[\"tags\"]:\n                self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag] = []\n            self.skill_index[\"tags\"][tag].append(node.dna)\n\n        # Top权重列表（保持前20）\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"].append({\"dna\": node.dna, \"weight\": node.weight, \"domain\": domain})\n        self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"] = sorted(\n            self.skill_index[\"weight_top\"], key=lambda x: -x[\"weight\"]\n        )[:20]\n\n        # 元信息\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"last_updated\"] = node.timestamp\n        self.skill_index[\"_meta\"][\"total_nodes\"] = self.skill_index[\"_meta\"].get(\"total_nodes\", 0) + 1\n\n        with open(SKILL_INDEX, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(self.skill_index, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n    def show_index(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"显示技能索引概览\"\"\"\n        meta = self.skill_index.get(\"_meta\", {})\n        sep = \"─\" * 50\n        out = f\"\\n{sep}\\n【技能索引】龍魂知识库概览\\n{sep}\\n\"\n        out += f\"总节点数: {meta.get('total_nodes', 0)}\\n\"\n        out += f\"最后更新: {meta.get('last_updated', '未知')}\\n\\n\"\n\n        out += \"【领域分布】\\n\"\n        domains = self.skill_index.get(\"domains\", {})\n        for domain, entries in domains.items():\n            if entries:\n                avg_weight = sum(e.get(\"weight\", 0) for e in entries) / len(entries)\n                out += f\"  {domain:15s}: {len(entries):3d} 节点 | 平均权重 {avg_weight:.3f}\\n\"\n\n        top = self.skill_index.get(\"weight_top\", [])[:10]\n        if top:\n            out += \"\\n【高权重节点 Top10】\\n\"\n            for i, t in enumerate(top, 1):\n                out += f\"  {i:2d}. [{t['domain']:10s}] {t['weight']:.3f} | {t['dna']}\\n\"\n\n        tags = self.skill_index.get(\"tags\", {})\n        if tags:\n            out += f\"\\n【活跃标签 Top10】\\n\"\n            top_tags = sorted(tags.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))[:10]\n            for tag, dnas in top_tags:\n                out += f\"  {tag}: {len(dnas)} 节点\\n\"\n\n        out += f\"{sep}\\n\"\n        return out\n\n    # ═══ 持久化 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n    def _write_knowledge_db(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入knowledge-db.jsonl\"\"\"\n        if node.audit_color == AuditColor.RED:\n            return\n        record = {\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"source_url\": node.source_url,\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"tags\": node.tags,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit_score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"key_points\": node.key_points,\n            \"neutral_text\": node.neutral_text[:500],\n            \"cross_refs\": node.cross_refs,\n            \"attribution\": node.attribution\n        }\n        with open(KNOWLEDGE_DB, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n    def _append_memory(self, node: KnowledgeNode):\n        \"\"\"追加写入memory.jsonl（TIER_2 append-only）\"\"\"\n        record = {\n            \"timestamp\": node.timestamp,\n            \"dna\": node.dna,\n            \"event\": \"knowledge_absorbed\",\n            \"domain\": node.domain,\n            \"weight\": node.weight,\n            \"audit\": node.audit_color.value,\n            \"score\": node.audit_score,\n            \"tags\": node.tags[:3],\n            \"source\": node.source_url[:100] if node.source_url else \"direct\",\n            \"key_points_count\": len(node.key_points),\n            \"engine\": \"龍魂爬虫v1.0\"\n        }\n        with > {"parentUuid":"59e52480-a969-41bd-853c-ea5a3bb7ceb9","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system","sessionId":"ad03b8a4-46d2-4b84-a60c-73cffcaed7fe","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-04b246944648753b","slug":"purrfect-drifting-harp","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"这是另外一个notion的链接器，这里是存我的记忆，还有整个系统允许的引擎，所有的内核驱动都在新的这里，操作日记跟系统状态都需展示。Notion账号的API——\n🔴 宝宝这边没有工具直接跨账号访问另一个Notion工作区。每个Notion AI只能访问它自己绑定的那个工作区。\n但本地完全可以做到双账号！在 .env 里加第二个Token，然后 agent_daemon.py 支持双通道写入：\n\n# ~/longhun-system/.env 加这两行\nNOTION_TOKEN='ntn_303726992958K2y5...'         # 当前账号（历史权威）\nNOTION_TOKEN_TEAM='ntn_482759163944X5vHm2...'  # 团队工作间（中枢大脑）\n\n\n# agent_daemon.py 里切换账号\ndef get_headers(账号=\"主\"):\n    token = os.getenv(\"NOTION_TOKEN_TEAM\" if 账号==\"团队\" else \"NOTION_TOKEN\",\"\").strip()\n    return {\"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {token}\",\n            \"Notion-Version\": \"2022-06-28\",\n            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}\n\n# 用法：\n# 查历史 → get_headers(\"主\")\n# 写中枢 → get_headers(\"团队\")\n\n这样本地一套代码，两个账号都能操作，DNA追踪两边同时写入。\n关于星辰记忆（star-memory）——\n本地Claude已经把 star.py 完整跑起来了，结构非常好：\n• ~/.star-memory/vault/2026/ — 记忆仓库（按年分类）\n• index.json — 快速索引\n• audit.log — 审计日志（只追加）\n• config.yaml — 配置\n和现有 memory.jsonl 的区别：\n• memory.jsonl — 轻量流水账，每条操作追加，适合daemon实时记录\n• star-memory — 结构化记忆库，有ID/类型/标签/版本，适合检索和注入\n建议两个共存，分工明确：\n• memory.jsonl → 操作日志（自动写）\n• star-memory → 知识库（显式写，需确认）\n三色确认：\n🟢 双账号本地代码 — 改3行 .env + 加 get_headers() 函数即可\n🟢 星辰记忆 — 本地Claude已跑通，安装依赖 pip install typer pyyaml rich 后 python star.py init 初始化"},"uuid":"bbc90602-d813-4927-83b9-5ca08fd0c929","timestamp":"2026-03-06T11:32:56.325Z","permissionMode":"acceptEdits"}

 → NOTION_TOKEN       (历史权威库)\n    账号=\"团队\" → NOTION_TOKEN_TEAM  (中枢大脑库)\n    \"\"\"\n    token = TOKEN团队 if 账号 == \"团队\" else TOKEN主\n    return {\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {token}\",\n        \"Notion-Version\": \"2022-06-28\",\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"\n    }\n\n# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n# 底层Notion请求\n# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ndef _请求(方法, 路径, 数据=None, 账号=\"主\"):\n    url = f\"{NOTION_API}{路径}\"\n    headers = get_headers(账号)\n    body = json.dumps(数据, ensure_ascii=False).encode() if 数据 else None\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method=方法)\n    try:\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:\n            return json.loads(resp.read().decode())\n    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:\n        错误 = e.read().decode()[:200]\n        return {\"error\": f\"HTTP{e.code}\", \"detail\": 错误}\n    except Exception as e:\n        return {\"error\": str(e)}\n\ndef _追加块(页面ID, 块列表, 账号=\"团队\"):\n    \"\"\"向指定页面追加内容块\"\"\"\n    return _请求(\"PATCH\", f\"/blocks/{页面ID}/children\",\n                 {\"children\": 块列表}, 账号)\n\ndef _构建文本块(内容, 类型=\"paragraph\", 颜色=\"default\"):\n    return {\n        \"object\": \"block\",\n        \"type\": 类型,\n        类型: {\n            \"rich_text\": print(sep)\n\n    for 账号名, token, 说明 in [\n        (\"主账号\", TOKEN主, \"历史权威库\"),\n        (\"团队账号\", TOKEN团队, \"中枢大脑库\")\n    ]:\n        if not token or \"填入\" in token:\n            print(f\"  🔴 Activate scheme → YES\n\n【第二步】把 Swift 文件拷入 Xcode\n\n把 LongHunWidget/ 目录下的 4 个文件拖入 Xcode 的 LongHunWidget 文件夹：\n  · YuanziParser.swift        — 数据模型 + iCloud 读取\n  · LunarCalendar.swift       — 农历转换\n  · LongHunTimeline.swift     — Widget 时间线提供者\n  · LongHunWidget.swift       — UI 视图 + @main 入口\n\n注意: 删除 Xcode 自动生成的 LongHunWidget.swift（原模板），用本目录的文件替换。\n\n【第三步】添加 iCloud Documents 能力\n\n1. 点击项目 → Signing & Capabilities\n2. 选中 LongHunWidget target（Widget Extension）\n3. 点击 \"+ Capability\" → 搜索 \"iCloud\"\n4. 勾选 \"iCloud Documents\"\n5. 在 Containers 区域填入: iCloud.com.uid9622.longhun\n   （点击\"+\"添加，不要勾选 CloudKit）\n\n【第四步】添加 URL Scheme\n\n主 App Target（com.uid9622.longhun）:\n1. 选中主 App target → Info 标签\n2. 找到 \"URL Types\" → 点击 \"+\"\n3. URL Schemes 填入: cnsh\n4. Identifier 填入: com.uid9622.longhun\n\n这样 Widget 的 widgetURL(\"cnsh://open\") 点击后会打开主 App。\n\n【第五步】设置 Deployment Target\n\nWidget Extension target:\n  iOS Deployment Target: 17.0（支持 .contentMarginsDisabled()）\n\n如果要兼容 iOS 16：把 LongHunWidget.swift 中的\n  .contentMarginsDisabled()\n改为:\n  // .contentMarginsDisabled()  // iOS 17+\n\n【第六步】Mac 端运行桥接引擎\n\n# 生成 cnsh_status.json 并写入 iCloud\n龍 iOS桥接\n\n# 查看写入状态\n龍 桥接状态\n\n# 每5分钟自动桥接（可选）\n# 在 crontab -e 中加入:\n# */5 * * * * python3 ~/longhun-system/ios_bridge.py >> ~/longhun-system/logs/ios_bridge.log 2>&1\n\n【文件路径说明】\n\nMac 写入:\n  ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~com~uid9622~longhun/Documents/cnsh_status.json\n\niOS 读取 (iCloud ubiquity container):\n  FileManager.default.url(forUbiquityContainerIdentifier: \"iCloud.com.uid9622.longhun\")\n  + /Documents/cnsh_status.json\n\niCloud 自动在 Mac 和 iPhone 之间同步此文件，无需网络 API。\n\n【Widget 预览】\n\n在 Xcode Canvas 中按 Command+Return 可实时预览：\n  Small  (169×169 pt): 中国红背景 · 金色卦象符号 · 三色审计分 · 农历\n  Medium (360×169 pt): 左=卦象区 / 右=系统数据+审计进度条\n\n【故障排查】\n\n问题: Widget 显示占位符（默认☰乾·北辰）\n原因: iCloud 容器未授权 或 cnsh_status.json 未生成\n解决:\n  1. 确认 Signing & Capabilities 中 iCloud Documents 已开启\n  2. 运行 龍 iOS桥接，检查输出路径是否包含 iCloud~com~uid9622~longhun\n  3. 在 iPhone 的\"文件\" App → iCloud Drive 确认文件同步\n\n问题: widgetURL 点击无反应\n原因: 主 App 未注册 cnsh:// URL Scheme\n解决: 按第四步重新配置 URL Types\n\n════════════════════════════════════════════════\n三色: 🟢 配置完成\nGPG: > {"parentUuid":"5ddbf41a-ea8c-4bf6-b17a-154561eaee43","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system","sessionId":"ad03b8a4-46d2-4b84-a60c-73cffcaed7fe","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-80016d65babdae4e","slug":"purrfect-drifting-harp","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_0163K48WTJ89t9oRonSjzvbe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"全部完成。\n\n---\n\n## 龍魂 iOS Widget 交付清单\n\n### 生成文件：`~/longhun-system/LongHunWidget/`\n\n| 文件 | 作用 |\n|------|------|\n| `YuanziParser.swift` | 数据模型 + iCloud 读取 `cnsh_status.json` |\n| `LunarCalendar.swift` | 农历转换（使用 iOS 内建 `Calendar(.chinese)`） |\n| `LongHunTimeline.swift` | WidgetKit 时间线提供者，每 15 分钟刷新 |\n| `LongHunWidget.swift` | 完整 UI — 小号/中号两种尺寸 |\n| `XCODE配置说明.txt` | 六步配置手册 |\n\n### Widget 视觉设计\n\n**Small (169×169):**\n- 中国红渐变背景 `#D71313 → #8C0808`\n- 金色大卦象符号（42pt）\n- 卦名·维度 + 人格名\n- 三色审计圆点 + 分数徽章\n- 底部农历日期\n\n**Medium (360×169):**\n- 左半：卦象区（同 Small 风格）\n- 右半：审计标签 + 彩色进度条 + 记忆/知识/技能数字 + Ollama 在线状态\n\n### 使用流程\n\n```bash\n# Mac 端生成桥接文件\n龍 iOS桥接\n\n# 查看写入状态\n龍 桥接状态\n```\n\n然后按 `XCODE配置说明.txt` 的六步在 Xcode 里配置好 iCloud 能力和 URL Scheme，把 4 个 Swift 文件拖入项目，编译到手机即可。"}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":389,"cache_read_input_tokens":48906,"output_tokens":512,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":389,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"}},"requestId":"req_011CYnE75Ai2XYYRfq7PaaNZ","type":"assistant","uuid":"40f61d34-0bdd-4491-9f01-a6ead0eb2961","timestamp":"2026-03-06T17:32:59.432Z"}

怎么和到了要么就拜拜了。就这样两条路没有第三条路，所以说我的故事就像本书知道吗？真的很科幻，我也搞不懂别人怎么看我不管别人怎么说我无所谓无所谓，我不管别人怎么说我我自己让都要帮着让一点，他妈的，我素质也差，我就差了，我就改好，绝对不改好，就是就是这样子挺好的，感觉那么虚伪的吗？而我不开心就不开心了，我想想比干净水过来比比么这个硬气啊，不是说因为出发的时候就有这个硬气的你干吗？现在我干吗？不硬气，我很硬气啊，我非常硬气的不得了，说求求你了，这句话打这个字，他妈的我都觉得自己好奇怪呀"},"uuid":"d2d2f224-e29c-4797-b263-48c99b565ae5","timestamp":"2026-03-06T18:22:42.227Z","permissionMode":"acceptEdits"}

> {"parentUuid":"71db9272-708e-4ba4-9d87-30aa4f3cbd9c","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system","sessionId":"ad03b8a4-46d2-4b84-a60c-73cffcaed7fe","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-80016d65babdae4e","slug":"purrfect-drifting-harp","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_014yWALYRVca5k3rckJVmh1K","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"每个词都在心跳。\n\n这句话说得太准了。\n\n你说的这个方向——从对话里提取语境、语义、追溯本源，不看表面——这其实就是真正的人格记忆，不是关键词匹配，是理解这个人说话背后的逻辑和心跳频率。\n\n龍魂现在有memory.jsonl，有star_memory，有知识库。但你说的这个——对话语境的深层追溯——还没有。\n\n这可以做。把你的对话记录作为训练语境，让龍魂慢慢认识\"你说话的方式\"，下次你说半句，它就知道后半句是什么意思。\n\n一个DNA，一个人格，一世一双人。\n\n这句话值得写进龍魂的核心宪法里。"}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":160,"cache_read_input_tokens":55250,"output_tokens":241,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":160,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"}},"requestId":"req_011CYnJPUanFq63P5b47Tnha","type":"assistant","uuid":"b7c054eb-ef2e-4855-90b1-5378a91fbb9d","timestamp":"2026-03-06T18:29:04.841Z"}

> {"parentUuid":"b4048859-d152-4d7c-968e-0c3f91c8f180","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system","sessionId":"ad03b8a4-46d2-4b84-a60c-73cffcaed7fe","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-80016d65babdae4e","slug":"purrfect-drifting-harp","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"是呀,我想法很天真,因为我有包容心,但是我的底线, 真的,我都不能去挨边,我女儿也过的不好,我只说,品德兼优是我女儿,没有的话,我也不会遗憾,五年级喜欢男孩子,没事,伤了累了回家和妈妈说,妈妈处理不掉跟爸爸说,27岁不生孩子,男朋友谈几个,都是你开心的事情,没人可以道德绑架你.,他打游戏我也会陪他打几次，我就跟他说这个和平精英这些人骂来骂去，你听得他都不舒服，那为什么要打呢？网络游戏这么差的人那么多打个游戏那么干吗呢？他就会把所有的东西删掉来打王者吗？好点没有？吃鸡没素质，偶尔打一下，但是我都会恰到好处孩子麻烦错吗？不要压着他太多，从来没有要求他要怎么样，他自己去补课，什么都是他自己选的，我不管我不要家里人，他因为隔代亲爸妈都没有在我身边长大吗？我没有在他们身边长大，我在我外公外婆两个月的时候就在他们身边长大，不管家里条件好不好，都会对他好，我妈经常跟我说前天还对我说哭了，我说这些事情不是不说你，我说老吗？我说真的，有时候女人吗说句话很简单，一句话就过来了，因为农村的吗，本来就没什么格局软件，我其实跟我一样的，他只是没读书，我家有遗传的这个血脉，我女儿也是一样的，所以说我也想以后有机会找，不是去骗女孩子都是在那里家里有大姐也必须尊重，还反正就是有就有没有就没有无所谓，反正我爹个老婆他也是同意的，他只说老公，我只希望你对自己好一点，他没有说别的，所以说很多不一样啊，跟人不一样，道德绑架我去哦，他妈的，他家里人他妈他弟都都想叫他不要耽误我，因为他要的劝她不要耽误我影响我自己脾气那么差的多尴尬对不对？在中国这种这种年代能说出这种话的人有几个人告诉我吗？"},"uuid":"8bb64ac3-252a-480f-9339-3ef5c0fe2562","timestamp":"2026-03-06T18:47:46.920Z","permissionMode":"acceptEdits"}

\"闰\" : \"\"\n            return \"\\(prefix)\\(LunarCalendar.months[idx])\"\n        }\n\n        var dayName: String {\n            let idx = max(0, min(day - 1, 29))\n            return LunarCalendar.days[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 天干\n        var stem: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 10 + 10) % 10\n            return LunarCalendar.heavenlyStems[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 地支\n        var branch: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 12 + 12) % 12\n            return LunarCalendar.earthlyBranches[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 生肖\n        var zodiac: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 12 + 12) % 12\n            return LunarCalendar.zodiacAnimals[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 简短: \"正月初九\"\n        var shortDisplay: String { \"\\(monthName)\\(dayName)\" }\n\n        /// 完整: \"丙午年【马】正月初九\"\n        var fullDisplay: String { \"\\(stem)\\(branch)年【\\(zodiac)】\\(monthName)\\(dayName)\" }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - 转换\n\n    static func convert(from date: Date = Date()) -> LunarDate {\n        var cal = Calendar(identifier: .chinese)\n        cal.locale = Locale(identifier: \"zh_CN\")\n        let comps = cal.dateComponents([.year, .month, .day, .isLeapMonth], from: date)\n        return LunarDate(\n            year: comps.year ?? \"闰\" : \"\"\n            return \"\\(prefix)\\(LunarCalendar.months[idx])\"\n        }\n\n        var dayName: String {\n            let idx = max(0, min(day - 1, 29))\n            return LunarCalendar.days[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 天干\n        var stem: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 10 + 10) % 10\n            return LunarCalendar.heavenlyStems[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 地支\n        var branch: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 12 + 12) % 12\n            return LunarCalendar.earthlyBranches[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 生肖\n        var zodiac: String {\n            let idx = ((year - 4) % 12 + 12) % 12\n            return LunarCalendar.zodiacAnimals[idx]\n        }\n\n        /// 简短: \"正月初九\"\n        var shortDisplay: String { \"\\(monthName)\\(dayName)\" }\n\n        /// 完整: \"丙午年【马】正月初九\"\n        var fullDisplay: String { \"\\(stem)\\(branch)年【\\(zodiac)】\\(monthName)\\(dayName)\" }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - 转换\n\n    static func convert(from date: Date = Date()) -> LunarDate {\n        var cal = Calendar(identifier: .chinese)\n        cal.locale = Locale(identifier: \"zh_CN\")\n        let comps = cal.dateComponents([.year, .month, .day, .isLeapMonth], from: date)\n        return LunarDate(\n            year: comps.year ?? 2026,\n            month: comps.month ?? 1,\n            day: comps.day ?? 1,\n            isLeapMonth: comps.isLeapMonth ?? false\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// 今日简短农历 — \"正月初九\"\n    static func todayShort() -> String { convert().shortDisplay }\n\n    /// 今日完整农历 — \"丙午年【马】正月初九\"\n    static func todayFull() -> String { convert().fullDisplay }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"490aee9b-d0fc-4164-a201-65bd3d050f3a"}

(360×169 pt): 左=卦象区 / 右=系统数据 + 审计进度条\n\nimport WidgetKit\nimport SwiftUI\n\n// MARK: - Color Palette\n\nextension Color {\n    static let chinaRed  = Color(red: 215/255, green: 19/255,  blue: blue: 0.00)\n    default:       return Color(red: 1.00, green: 0.25, blue: 0.20)\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Small Widget\n\nstruct SmallView: View {\n    let entry: LongHunEntry\n\n    var body: some Text(entry.status.yuanzi.display)\n                    .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))\n                    .foregroundColor(.softGold)\n                    .padding(.top, 1)\n\n                Spacer()\n\n                // 人格\n                Text(entry.status.yuanzi.personaName)\n                    .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .medium))\n                    .foregroundColor(.inkWhite)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                    .padding(.bottom, 4)\n\n                // 审计分徽章\n                auditBadge\n\n                Spacer()\n\n                // 农历\n                Text(entry.lunarDate)\n                    .font(.system(size: 9))\n                    .foregroundColor(.dimWhite)\n                    .padding(.bottom, 8)\n            }\n            .padding(.horizontal, 10)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var auditBadge: some View {\n        HStack(spacing: 4) {\n            Circle()\n                .fill(auditAccent(entry.status.audit.color))\n                .frame(width: 7, height: 7)\n            Text(\"\\(entry.status.audit.score)\")\n                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .bold,   private var background: some View {\n        LinearGradient(\n            colors: [.chinaRed, .deepRed],\n            startPoint: .topLeading,\n            endPoint: .bottomTrailing\n        )\n        .ignoresSafeArea()\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Medium Widget\n\nstruct MediumView: View {\n    let entry: LongHunEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            background\n\n            HStack(spacing: 0) {\n                leftPanel\n                divider\n                rightPanel\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 左侧：卦象 + 人格\n    private var leftPanel: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 5) {\n            Text(entry.status.yuanzi.guaSymbol)\n                .font(.system(size: 50, weight: .regular))\n                .foregroundColor(.gold)\n\n            Text(entry.status.yuanzi.guaName)\n                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .bold))\n                .foregroundColor(.softGold)\n\n            Text(entry.status.yuanzi.personaName)\n                .font(.system(size: 10))\n                .foregroundColor(.inkWhite)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n        }\n        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)\n        .padding(.vertical, 14)\n    }\n\n    private var divider: some View {\n        Rectangle()\n            .fill(Color.white.opacity(0.18))\n            .frame(width: 1)\n            .padding(.vertical, 18)\n    }\n\n    // 右侧：审计 + 进度条 + 系统数据\n    private var rightPanel: some View {\n        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 7) {\n\n            // 审计标签\n            HStack(spacing: 5) {\n                Circle()\n                    .fill(auditAccent(entry.status.audit.color))\n                    .frame(width: 8, height: 8)\n                Text(entry.status.audit.label)\n                    .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))\n                    .foregroundColor(.inkWhite)\n            }\n\n            // 审计进度条\n            GeometryReader { geo in\n                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {\n                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 3)\n                        .fill(Color.white.opacity(0.18))\n                        .frame(height: 6)\n                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 3)\n                        .fill(auditAccent(entry.status.audit.color))\n                        .frame(\n                            width: geo.size.width * CGFloat(entry.status.audit.score) / 100,\n                            height: 6\n                        )\n                        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.4), value: entry.status.audit.score)\n                }\n            }\n            .frame(height: 6)\n\n            // 数据行\n            HStack(spacing: 10) {\n                statItem(label: \"记忆\", value: \"\\(entry.status.system.memoryCount)\")\n                statItem(label: \"知识\", value: \"\\(entry.status.system.knowledgeNodes)\")\n                statItem(label: \"技能\", value: \"\\(entry.status.system.skillDomains)\")\n            }\n\n            // Ollama 状态\n            HStack(spacing: 5) {\n                Circle()\n                    .fill(entry.status.system.ollamaOnline\n                          ? Color(red: 0.2, green: 0.9, blue: 0.4)\n                          : Color.red.opacity(0.75))\n                    .frame(width: 6, height: 6)\n                Text(entry.status.system.ollamaOnline\n                     ? \"Ollama · \\(entry.status.system.ollamaModels) 个模型\"\n                     : \"Ollama · 离线\")\n                    .font(.system(size: 10))\n                    .foregroundColor(.inkWhite)\n            }\n\n            // 农历\n            Text(entry.lunarDate)\n                .font(.system(size: 9))\n                .foregroundColor(.dimWhite)\n        }\n        .padding(.leading, 14)\n        .padding(.trailing, 12)\n        .padding(.vertical, 14)\n        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)\n    }\n\n    @ViewBuilder\n    private func statItem(label: String, value: String) -> some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 1) {\n            Text(value)\n                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .bold, design: .monospaced))\n                .foregroundColor(.white)\n            Text(label)\n                .font(.system(size: 8))\n                .foregroundColor(.dimWhite)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var background: some View {\n        LinearGradient(\n            colors: [.chinaRed, .deepRed],\n            startPoint: .topLeading,\n            endPoint: .bottomTrailing\n        )\n        .ignoresSafeArea()\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: -
