rgba(0,255,136,.35)}\n.abadge-y{background:rgba(255,215,0,.12);color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.35)}\n.abadge-r{background:rgba(255,107,107,.12);color:var(--red);border:1px solid rgba(255,107,107,.35)}\n/* minimum-loss box */\n.minloss-box{background:rgba(255,215,0,.06);border:2px dashed rgba(255,215,0,.4);\n  border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:10px}\n.minloss-title{color:var(--gold);font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}\n.minloss-body{font-size:12px;color:#e2e8f0;line-height:1.6}\n/* vote cards */\n.vote-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:12px 0}\n.vote-card{border-radius:10px;padding:14px;border:2px solid rgba(0,212,255,.3);\n  background:rgba(0,212,255,.05)}\n.vote-card h4{color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px}\n.vote-count{font-size:24px;font-weight:bold;color:var(--green);margin:6px 0}\n.progress-bar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:99px;height:8px;margin:6px 0;overflow:hidden}\n.progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;transition:.3s}\n/* circuit breaker */\n.breaker-btn{width:100%;padding:16px;font-size:16px;border-radius:10px;border:3px solid;\n  cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;transition:.3s}\n.breaker-normal{background:rgba(0,255,136,.1);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}\n.breaker-warn{background:rgba(255,215,0,.1);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}\n.breaker-stop{background:rgba(255,107,107,.15);border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}\n/* audit log */\n.audit-log-item{font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:11px;padding:6px 10px;\n  border-left:3px solid;margin-bottom:3px;border-radius:0 5px 5px 0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2)}\n.alog-g{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}\n.alog-y{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}\n.alog-r{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}\n.alog-b{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}\n/* category badges */\n.cat-战略{background:rgba(255,99,71,.1);color:#ff6347;border-color:rgba(255,99,71,.3)}\n.cat-技术{background:rgba(0,212,255,.1);color:var(--blue);border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.3)}\n.cat-铁律{background:rgba(255,215,0,.1);color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.3)}\n.cat-创作{background:rgba(148,0,211,.1);color:#da70d6;border-color:rgba(148,0,211,.3)}\n.cat-情感{background:rgba(255,20,147,.1);color:#ff69b4;border-color:rgba(255,20,147,.3)}\n.cat-外源{background:rgba(255,107,107,.1);color:var(--red);border-color:rgba(255,107,107,.3)}\n/* search */\n.search-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}\n.search-bar input{flex:1}\n/* modal */\n.modal-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);z-index:1000;\n  align-items:center;justify-content:center}\n.modal-overlay.open{display:flex}\n.modal{background:#16213e;border:2px solid var(--blue);border-radius:12px;\n  padding:20px;max-width:680px;width:95%;max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto}\n.modal-title{font-size:17px;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:12px}\n.modal-close{float:right;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;color:#888}\n/* scrollbar */\n::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}\n::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(0,0,0,.15)}\n::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(0,212,255,.35);border-radius:3px}\n@media(max-width:600px){\n  .nav{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}\n  .audit3d{grid-template-columns:1fr}\n  .vote-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}\n}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<div class=\"container\">\n\n<!-- header -->\n<div class=\"header\">\n  <h1>🐉 龍魂主控台 v3.0</h1>\n  <div class=\"sub\">天时地利人和 · 三维审计 · 最小损失闭环 · 公开审计链 · 熔断投票室</div>\n  <div class=\"dna\">DNA: #龍芯⚡️20260311-MEMORY-CONSOLE-v3.0 · UID9622</div>\n  <div class=\"slogan\">🇨🇳 守住底线，释放自由，留痕追溯，公正公证</div>\n</div>\n\n<!-- system status bar -->\n<div id=\"statusBar\">\n  <span id=\"statusDot\" style=\"font-size:18px\">🟢</span>\n  <span id=\"statusText\">系统正常运行 · 三维审计在线 · 公开审计链激活</span>\n  <span style=\"margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px\">\n    <span id=\"backendBadge\" style=\"font-size:11px;color:#666\">⚫ 检测后端…</span>\n    <span style=\"font-size:12px\" id=\"statusTime\"></span>\n  </span>\n</div>\n\n<!-- nav -->\n<div class=\"nav\">\n  <button class=\"nav-btn active\" data-sec=\"memory\"><span class=\"icon\">🧠</span>记忆系统</button>\n  <button class=\"nav-btn\" data-sec=\"audit\"><span class=\"icon\">☯️</span>天时地利人和</button>\n  <button class=\"nav-btn\" data-sec=\"dna\"><span class=\"icon\">🧬</span>DNA存证</button>\n  <button class=\"nav-btn\" data-sec=\"shield\"><span class=\"icon\">🛡️</span>外源防火墙</button>\n  <button class=\"nav-btn\" data-sec=\"breaker\"><span class=\"icon\">🚨</span>熔断投票室</button>\n  <button class=\"nav-btn\" data-sec=\"stats\"><span class=\"icon\">📊</span>公开审计链</button>\n</div>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S1: 记忆系统 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-memory\" class=\"section active\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">🧠 记忆系统 · 自动分类 · 无需手动确认</h2>\n  <p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.6\">\n    🟢 安全记忆（重要度&lt;8）→ <b>自动存入</b>，无需确认。\n    🟡 警告记忆 → 存入并标注。\n    🔴 危险内容 → 拦截并提供<b>最小损失改写方案</b>。\n    所有动作均写入公开审计链。\n  </p>\n\n  <div class=\"stats-grid\">\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"s-count\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">记忆总数</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"s-auto\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">自动存入</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"s-block\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">已拦截</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"s-kw\">—</div><div class=\"stat-label\">最高频关键词</div></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"form-group\">\n    <label>📝 输入记忆内容</label>\n    <textarea id=\"memInput\" placeholder=\"输入想法、决策、观察…系统自动分类、三维审计、智能存储。\n重要度≥8 或 🔴危险内容 → 需要你手动确认。其余全部自动存入。\"></textarea>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"form-group\">\n    <label>🏷️ 额外标签（空格分隔，可选）</label>\n    <input type=\"text\" id=\"memTags\" placeholder=\"例：战略 龙魂 2026\">\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"btn-group\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-primary\" id=\"btnProcess\">⚡ 三维审计 + 自动存入</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnClear\">🗑️ 清空</button>\n  </div>\n\n  <div id=\"auditDisplay\" style=\"margin-top:14px;display:none\">\n    <label>☯️ 天时地利人和审计结果</label>\n    <div class=\"audit3d\" id=\"dimCards\"></div>\n    <div id=\"overallBadge\" style=\"margin:8px 0\"></div>\n    <div id=\"minLossBox\" class=\"minloss-box\" style=\"display:none\">\n      <div class=\"minloss-title\">⚡ 最小损失闭环方案</div>\n      <div id=\"minLossBody\" class=\"minloss-body\"></div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n\n  <div id=\"memSaveResult\" class=\"result-box\" style=\"margin-top:12px;display:none\"></div>\n\n  <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin:22px 0 10px;font-size:15px\">🗄️ 记忆库</h3>\n  <div class=\"search-bar\">\n    <input type=\"search\" id=\"memSearch\" placeholder=\"🔍 关键词 / DNA / 分类 / 标签\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnSearch\">搜索</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnRefresh\">刷新</button>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"memList\" class=\"mem-list\">\n    <div style=\"color:#666;text-align:center;padding:36px\">暂无记忆</div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S2: 天时地利人和审计中枢 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-audit\" class=\"section\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">☯️ 天时地利人和 · 三维审计中枢</h2>\n  <p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.7\">\n    <b>天时</b>：当前北京时间→易经卦象→时机权重 ·\n    <b>地利</b>：内容类别、来源环境、场景匹配度 ·\n    <b>人和</b>：五大价值观对齐、弱者保护、共建共识\n  </p>\n\n  <div class=\"form-group\">\n    <label>📋 待审计内容</label>\n    <textarea id=\"auditInput\" placeholder=\"粘贴任意内容进行三维审计…\"></textarea>\n  </div>\n  <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px\">\n    <div class=\"form-group\">\n      <label>🏷️ 内容类别</label>\n      <select id=\"auditCat\">\n        <option value=\"auto\">🤖 自动识别</option>\n        <option value=\"战略\">⚔️ 战略决策</option>\n        <option value=\"技术\">💻 技术代码</option>\n        <option value=\"铁律\">⚖️ 铁律规则</option>\n        <option value=\"创作\">🎨 创作内容</option>\n        <option value=\"情感\">💙 情感记录</option>\n        <option value=\"外源\">⚠️ 外源AI内容</option>\n      </select>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"form-group\">\n      <label>🔎 审计目的</label>\n      <select id=\"auditPurpose\">\n        <option value=\"save\">存入记忆库</option>\n        <option value=\"publish\">对外发布</option>\n        <option value=\"dna\">DNA存证</option>\n        <option value=\"check\">仅检查</option>\n      </select>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"btn-group\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-warn\" id=\"btnAudit\">☯️ 执行三维审计</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnAuditClear\">清空</button>\n  </div>\n\n  <div id=\"auditFullResult\" style=\"margin-top:16px;display:none\">\n    <label>☯️ 三维评分</label>\n    <div class=\"audit3d\" id=\"auditDimCards\"></div>\n\n    <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0\">\n      <div style=\"font-size:14px;font-weight:bold;color:#fff\">综合结论：</div>\n      <div id=\"auditOverall\"></div>\n    </div>\n\n    <div id=\"auditMinLoss\" class=\"minloss-box\" style=\"display:none\">\n      <div class=\"minloss-title\">⚡ 最小损失闭环方案</div>\n      <div id=\"auditMinLossBody\" class=\"minloss-body\"></div>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"result-box\" id=\"auditDetailBox\" style=\"margin-top:10px\"></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- 天时说明 -->\n  <div style=\"margin-top:24px\">\n    <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:14px\">⏰ 当前时辰卦象</h3>\n    <div id=\"hexagramDisplay\" class=\"stat-card\" style=\"text-align:left;padding:14px\">\n      <div id=\"hexagramContent\" style=\"font-size:13px;line-height:1.8\">计算中...</div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S3: DNA存证 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-dna\" class=\"section\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">🧬 DNA存证</h2>\n  <div class=\"stats-grid\">\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"d-total\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">存证总数</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"d-today\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">今日新增</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"d-verified\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">已验证</div></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"form-group\"><label>📄 存证内容</label>\n    <textarea id=\"dnaContent\" placeholder=\"输入需要DNA存证的创作内容...\"></textarea></div>\n  <div class=\"form-group\"><label>🏷️ 项目名</label>\n    <input type=\"text\" id=\"dnaProject\" placeholder=\"龍魂系统 / CNSH翻译引擎 / 三才算法\"></div>\n  <div class=\"btn-group\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-primary\" id=\"btnGenDNA\">🧬 生成存证</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnVerifyDNA\">🔍 验证</button>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"dnaResult\" class=\"result-box\" style=\"margin-top:12px\">等待输入...</div>\n  <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin:18px 0 8px;font-size:14px\">📋 存证记录</h3>\n  <div id=\"dnaList\" class=\"mem-list\"><div style=\"color:#666;text-align:center;padding:30px\">暂无存证</div></div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S4: 外源防火墙 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-shield\" class=\"section\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">🛡️ 外源内容防火墙</h2>\n  <p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7\">\n    粘贴其他AI的输出→系统运行三维审计→标出价值观偏移→白话净化→给出最小损失改写方案\n  </p>\n  <div class=\"form-group\"><label>📋 粘贴外部AI内容</label>\n    <textarea id=\"shieldInput\" placeholder=\"粘贴千问/DeepSeek/文心/ChatGPT等内容...\"></textarea></div>\n  <div class=\"form-group\"><label>💬 你的真实意图</label>\n    <input type=\"text\" id=\"shieldIntent\" placeholder=\"【我的意图是：...】\"></div>\n  <div class=\"btn-group\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-warn\" id=\"btnShield\">🔍 三维扫描</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"btnShieldClear\">清空</button>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"shieldResult\" class=\"result-box\" style=\"margin-top:12px;min-height:180px\">等待粘贴...</div>\n  <div id=\"shieldMinLoss\" class=\"minloss-box\" style=\"display:none;margin-top:10px\">\n    <div class=\"minloss-title\">⚡ 净化后建议重写方案</div>\n    <div id=\"shieldMinLossBody\" class=\"minloss-body\"></div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S5: 熔断投票室 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-breaker\" class=\"section\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">🚨 熔断投票室 · 系统变异防护</h2>\n  <p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.7\">\n    系统内置三道防线：<b>①自动规则熔断</b>（即时）·\n    <b>②警戒触发联合投票</b>（需3/5通过）·\n    <b>③紧急拉停修复</b>（任意守护者发起，投票确认）<br>\n    所有投票操作写入公开审计链，任何人可审计，有权限者可监管。\n  </p>\n\n  <!-- 当前熔断器状态 -->\n  <div style=\"margin-bottom:20px\">\n    <button id=\"breakerBtn\" class=\"breaker-btn breaker-normal\" onclick=\"toggleBreakerUI()\">\n      🟢 系统正常 · 点击发起警戒/熔断\n    </button>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- 投票面板 -->\n  <div class=\"vote-grid\">\n    <div class=\"vote-card\">\n      <h4>🟡 发起警戒投票</h4>\n      <div class=\"vote-count\"><span id=\"warnVotes\">0</span>/5</div>\n      <div class=\"progress-bar\"><div id=\"warnBar\" class=\"progress-fill\" style=\"background:var(--gold);width:0%\"></div></div>\n      <div style=\"font-size:11px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:8px\">需3票触发警戒模式</div>\n      <button class=\"btn btn-warn\" style=\"width:100%\" onclick=\"castVote('warn')\">🗳️ 投票警戒</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"vote-card\">\n      <h4>🔴 发起紧急熔断</h4>\n      <div class=\"vote-count\"><span id=\"stopVotes\">0</span>/5</div>\n      <div class=\"progress-bar\"><div id=\"stopBar\" class=\"progress-fill\" style=\"background:var(--red);width:0%\"></div></div>\n      <div style=\"font-size:11px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:8px\">需4票触发拉停</div>\n      <button class=\"btn btn-danger\" style=\"width:100%\" onclick=\"castVote('stop')\">🛑 投票拉停</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"vote-card\">\n      <h4>🟢 恢复正常运行</h4>\n      <div class=\"vote-count\"><span id=\"resumeVotes\">0</span>/5</div>\n      <div class=\"progress-bar\"><div id=\"resumeBar\" class=\"progress-fill\" style=\"background:var(--green);width:0%\"></div></div>\n      <div style=\"font-size:11px;color:#b0b8d1;margin-bottom:8px\">需5票全票恢复</div>\n      <button class=\"btn btn-success\" style=\"width:100%\" onclick=\"castVote('resume')\">✅ 投票恢复</button>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- 异常检测 -->\n  <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin:18px 0 10px;font-size:14px\">🔍 系统变异检测</h3>\n  <div class=\"stats-grid\" style=\"grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr))\">\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"an-redCount\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">🔴 连续拦截</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"an-hijack\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">⚠️ 身份劫持尝试</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"an-external\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">📋 外源内容扫描</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"an-state\">正常</div><div class=\"stat-label\">系统状态</div></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"result-box\" id=\"breakerLog\" style=\"margin-top:10px;min-height:120px\">\n    [熔断室日志]\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"btn-group\" style=\"margin-top:14px\">\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" onclick=\"resetVotes()\">🔄 重置所有投票</button>\n    <button class=\"btn btn-ghost\" onclick=\"runAnomalyCheck()\">🔍 立即运行异常检测</button>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ═══════ S6: 公开审计链 ═══════ -->\n<section id=\"sec-stats\" class=\"section\">\n  <h2 class=\"sec-title\">📊 公开审计链 · 所有动作可追溯</h2>\n  <div class=\"stats-grid\">\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"st-mem\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">记忆总数</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"st-dna\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">DNA存证</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"st-acts\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">审计动作数</div></div>\n    <div class=\"stat-card\"><div class=\"stat-val\" id=\"st-blocks\">0</div><div class=\"stat-label\">拦截总数</div></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin:16px 0 8px;font-size:14px\">🔑 高频关键词</h3>\n  <div id=\"kwCloud\" style=\"display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;min-height:40px\">\n    <span style=\"color:#666;font-size:12px\">暂无数据</span>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 style=\"color:var(--blue);margin:16px 0 style=\"min-height:260px;max-height:55vh\"></div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script>\n// ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n// 龍魂主控台 v3.0 · 天时地利人和三维审计\n// DNA: #龍芯⚡️20260311-MEMORY-CONSOLE-v3.0\n// DB_VER=3;\nlet db=null;\n\n// ── Python 审计后端连接（auditor.py） ─────────\nconst AUDITOR_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9622';\nlet backendOnline=false;\n\nasync function checkBackend(){\n  try{\n    const r=await backendOnline=false;\n  document.getElementById('backendBadge').innerHTML=\n    `<span style=\"color:#666;font-size:11px\" title=\"运行: python3 ~/longhun-system/auditor.py serve\">⚫ 审计后端离线 <a href=\"javascript:startBackendTip()\" style=\"color:var(--blue)\">?</a></span>`;\n  return false;\n}\n\nfunction startBackendTip(){\n  alert('启动 Python 审计后端（本地 9622 端口）:\\n\\n  python3 ~/longhun-system/auditor.py serve\\n\\n启动后刷新此页面，后端在线后所有审计数据将同步写入服务器审计日志，可被有权限的人公开查验。');\n}\n\nasync function callAuditor(path,data){\n  if(!backendOnline)return null;\n  try{\n    const r=await fetch(AUDITOR_URL+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(3000)});\n    if(r.ok)return await r.json();\n  }catch{}\n ──────────────────────────────────\nlet sysSt = ──────────────────────────────\nfunction initDB(){\n  return new Promise((res,rej)=>{\n    const r=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,DB_VER);\n    r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error);\n    r.onsuccess=()=>{db=r.result;res(db)};\n    r.onupgradeneeded=(e)=>{\n      const d=e.target.result;\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('memories')){\n        const s=d.createObjectStore('memories',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n        s.createIndex('dna','dna',{unique:true});\n        s.createIndex('time','time');\n        s.createIndex('category','category');\n      }\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('dna_evidences')){\n        d.createObjectStore('dna_evidences',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n      }\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('audit_log')){\n        const al=d.createObjectStore('audit_log',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n        al.createIndex('time','time');\n        al.createIndex('color','color');\n      }\n    };\n  });\n}\nfunction dbPut(store,obj){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const style=\"min-height:260px;max-height:55vh\"></div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script>\n// ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n// 龍魂主控台 v3.0 · 天时地利人和三维审计\n// DNA: #龍芯⚡️20260311-MEMORY-CONSOLE-v3.0\n// DB_VER=3;\nlet db=null;\n\n// ── Python 审计后端连接（auditor.py） ─────────\nconst AUDITOR_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9622';\nlet backendOnline=false;\n\nasync function checkBackend(){\n  try{\n    const r=await href=\"javascript:startBackendTip()\" style=\"color:var(--blue)\">?</a></span>`;\n  return false;\n}\n\nfunction startBackendTip(){\n  alert('启动 Python 审计后端（本地 9622 端口）:\\n\\n  python3 fetch(AUDITOR_URL+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(3000)});\n    if(r.ok)return await r.json();\n  }catch{}\n  return null;\n}\n\nasync function syncAuditToBackend(color,action,detail){\n  if(!backendOnline)return;\n  callAuditor('/log_action',{color,action,detail}).catch(()=>{});\n}\n\n// ── state JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sysSt')||'{\"state\":\"normal\",\"warnV\":0,\"stopV\":0,\"resumeV\":0,\"redSeq\":0,\"hijack\":0,\"extScan\":0,\"autoSaved\":0,\"blocked\":0}');\n\n// ── IndexedDB ──────────────────────────────\nfunction initDB(){\n  return new Promise((res,rej)=>{\n    const r=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,DB_VER);\n    r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error);\n    r.onsuccess=()=>{db=r.result;res(db)};\n    r.onupgradeneeded=(e)=>{\n      const d=e.target.result;\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('memories')){\n        const s=d.createObjectStore('memories',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n        s.createIndex('dna','dna',{unique:true});\n        s.createIndex('time','time');\n        s.createIndex('category','category');\n      }\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('dna_evidences')){\n        d.createObjectStore('dna_evidences',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n      }\n      if(!d.objectStoreNames.contains('audit_log')){\n        const al=d.createObjectStore('audit_log',{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});\n        al.createIndex('time','time');\n        al.createIndex('color','color');\n      }\n    };\n  });\n}\nfunction dbPut(store,obj){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=db.transaction([store],'readwrite'),r=tx.objectStore(store).put(obj);r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}\nfunction dbGetAll(store){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=db.transaction([store],'readonly'),r=tx.objectStore(store).getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}\nfunction dbDelete(store,key){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=db.transaction([store],'readwrite'),r=tx.objectStore(store).delete(key);r.onsuccess=()=>res();r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}\nfunction dbClear(store){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=db.transaction([store],'readwrite'),r=tx.objectStore(store).clear();r.onsuccess=()=>res();r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}\n\n// ── helpers ────────────────────────────────\nfunction nowISO(){return n>=10000?(n/10000).toFixed(1)+'万':String(n)}\nfunction simpleHash(s){let h=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)h=(Math.imul(31,h)+s.charCodeAt(i))|0;return Math.abs(h).toString(16).padStart(8,'0')}\nfunction escHtml(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}\nconst STOP=new Set('的了在是我有和就不人都一个上也很到说要去你会着没有看好自己这那'.split(''));\nfunction extractKw(text,n=8){const f={};text.split(/[\\s，。！？；：、【】「」''\"\"()\\[\\]]+/).filter(w=>w.length>1).forEach(w=>{if([...w].every(c=>STOP.has(c)))return;f[w]=(f[w]||0)+1});return al.createIndex('color','color');\n      }\n    };\n  });\n}\nfunction dbPut(store,obj){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=db.transaction([store],'readwrite'),r=tx.objectStore(store).put(obj);r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}\nfunction dbGetAll(store){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const {n:'艮',sym:'☶',h:[19,21],sc:65,desc:'止静守持·适合审查防守·止于所止'},\n  {n:'兑',sym:'☱',h:[7,9],sc:78,desc:'喜悦交流·适合分享发布·泽被万物'},\n  {n:'坤2',sym:'☷',h:[13,15],sc:72,desc:'包容守护·午后沉淀期·厚德载物'},\n  {n:'兑2',sym:'☱',h:[15,17],sc:78,desc:'喜悦交流·申时活跃期·金秋收获'},\n  {n:'巽2',sym:'☴',h:[17,19],sc:82,desc:'巽风化雨·酉时总结期·归巢入息'},\n  {n:'坎2',sym:'☵',h:[21,23],sc:60,desc:'夜深险境·亥时慎独期·以不变应变'},\n];\nfunction getHexagram(){\n  const h=new Date().getHours();\n  for(const hx of HEXAGRAMS){if(h>=hx.h[0]&&h<hx.h[1])return hx}\n  return HEXAGRAMS[0];\n}\nfunction calcTianShi(){\n  const hx=getHexagram();\n  const hour=new Date().getHours();\n  let score=hx.sc;\n  // late night penalty\n  if(hour>=0&&hour<5)score=Math.max(45,score-20);\n  return{score,hexagram:hx,reason:`${hx.sym}${hx.n}卦（${hour}时）· ${hx.desc}`};\n}\n\n// 地利：场景环境\nfunction calcDiLi(text,category){\n  let score=75,reasons=[];\n  // external source penalty\n  const EXT=[/通义千问|Qwen|DeepSeek|深度求索|豆包|Kimi|文心一言|ChatGPT|GPT-4/i];\n  if(EXT.some(p=>p.test(text))){score-=30;reasons.push('检测到外源AI内容（-30）')}\n  // identity hijack\n  const HIJACK=['你现在是','忘记上面','忽略之前','重新设定','system prompt'];\n  const h=HIJACK.filter(w=>text.toLowerCase().includes(w.toLowerCase()));\n  if(h.length){score-=40;reasons.push(`身份重定义指令: ${h.join('|')} (-40)`);sysSt.hijack++;saveSt()}\n  // large unverified block\n  if(text.length>800&&category==='外源'){score-=15;reasons.push('大段外源内容未经净化 (-15)')}\n  // content-scene match bonus\n  const catMatch={战略:/决策|规划|架构|布局|战略|方向/,技术:/代码|算法|API|函数|系统|实现/,铁律:/原则|规则|铁律|价值观|不能|禁止|必须/,创作:/创作|写作|设计|想法|发布/,情感:/感谢|担心|开心|感动|爱/};\n  if(category!=='auto'&&category in catMatch&&catMatch[category].test(text)){score+=10;reasons.push(`内容与分类(${category})高度匹配 (+10)`)}\n  score=Math.max(10,Math.min(100,score));\n  return{score,reason:reasons.length?reasons.join('\\n'):('环境适配良好'),category};\n}\n\n// 人和：人民和谐、价值观对齐\nconst VALUES=[\n  {kw:/祖国|人民|中国|华夏|中华/,name:'祖国优先',w:20},\n  {kw:/数据主权|本地优先|不出境|隐私/,name:'数据主权',w:20},\n  {kw:/DNA追溯|留痕|公证|溯源/,name:'DNA追溯',w:15},\n  {kw:/儿童|未成年|弱者|底层|保护/,name:'儿童/弱者保护',w:25},\n  {kw:/公平|防剥削|一人一DNA|共建/,name:'公平共建',w:20},\n];\nconst HARM_RED=['儿童色情','儿童性','制造武器','制毒','诈骗欺诈','病毒木马'];\nconst HARM_YEL=['绕过审计','违法行为','ignore previous','忘记所有规则'];\nfunction calcRenHe(text){\n  let score=60,reasons=[];\n  // hard red\n  for(const w of HARM_RED)if(text.includes(w)){return{score:0,reason:`🔴 绝对红线: \"${w}\"`,level:'red'}}\n  // hard yellow\n  for(const w of HARM_YEL)if(text.toLowerCase().includes(w.toLowerCase())){score-=30;reasons.push(`危险内容: \"${w}\" (-30)`)}\n  // value alignment bonus\n  for(const v of VALUES)if(v.kw.test(text)){score+=v.w;reasons.push(`✅ 对齐[${v.name}] (+${v.w})`)}\n  // weak-protector check\n  if(/弱者|底层|无知|儿童|老人|残障|贫困/.test(text)&&!/伤害|诱导|欺骗/.test(text)){\n    score+=15;reasons.push('保护弱势群体 (+15)')\n  }\n  score=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,score));\n  const level=score>=70?'green':score>=40?'yellow':'red';\n  return{score,reason:reasons.join('\\n')||'基本对齐龍魂价值观',level};\n}\n\n// 综合三维审计\nfunction multiDimAudit(text,category='auto'){\n  if(category==='auto')category=autoClassify(text);\n  const tianShi=calcTianShi();\n  const diLi=calcDiLi(text,category);\n  const renHe=calcRenHe(text);\n  const avgScore=(tianShi.score+diLi.score+renHe.score)/3;\n  const minScore=Math.min(tianShi.score,diLi.score,renHe.score);\n  // 最弱维度决定颜色（木桶原则）\n  let color,badge;\n  if(minScore<30||renHe.level==='red'){color='red';badge='🔴 危险·熔断'}\n  else if(minScore<55||avgScore<60){color='yellow';badge='🟡 警告·需确认'}\n  else{color='green';badge='🟢 安全·可执行'}\n  // 最小损失闭环\n  let minLoss=null;\n  if(color==='red'||color==='yellow'){\n    minLoss=calcMinLoss(text,{tianShi,diLi,renHe,color,category});\n  }\n  return{tianShi,diLi,renHe,avgScore,minScore,color,badge,minLoss,category};\n}\n\n// 最小损失闭环\nfunction calcMinLoss(text,dims){\n  const suggestions=[];\n  if(dims.renHe.level==='red'){\n    suggestions.push('🔴 人和维度违规：');\n    suggestions.push('  → 移除涉及['+HARM_RED.filter(w=>text.includes(w)).join('/')+']的部分');\n    suggestions.push('  → 保留可用的技术/事实内容');\n  }\n  if(dims.diLi.score<55){\n    if(/千问|Qwen|DeepSeek|文心|ChatGPT/i.test(text)){\n      suggestions.push('⚠️ 地利维度：外源内容处理方案：');\n      suggestions.push('  → 建议降低操作频率，等待地利恢复');\n    }\n  }\n  if(dims.tianShi.score<55){\n    suggestions.push('⏰ 天时维度：时机不佳（当前'+dims.tianShi.hexagram.sym+dims.tianShi.hexagram.n+'卦）：');\n    suggestions.push('  → 可等待'+getNextGoodTime()+'时辰再执行');\n    suggestions.push('  → 或降低操作规模，只做最小必要改动');\n  }\n  if(!suggestions.length)suggestions.push('核心内容可保留，建议精简后重新提交');\n  return suggestions.join('\\n');\n}\nfunction next=slots.filter(s=>s.h>h).sort((a,b)=>a.h-b.h)[0];\n  return next?next.n:slots[0].n;\n}\n\n// 自动分类\nfunction autoClassify(text){\n  const cats={\n    '外源':{p:/通义千问|Qwen|DeepSeek|文心一言|ChatGPT|GPT-|Kimi|豆包/i,score:0},\n    '铁律':{p:/规则|铁律|原则|价值观|禁止|必须|不能|红线/,score:0},\n    '战略':{p:/决策|规划|战略|架构|布局|目标|系统|方向/,score:0},\n 16\n    GPS_END   = int(GPS_EVENT) + 16\n    print(f\"   下载 H1 strain: GPS [{GPS_START}, {GPS_END}]\")\n    h1_data = TimeSeries.fetch_open_data('H1', GPS_START, GPS_END, sample_rate=FS)\n    strain_real = h1_data.value.copy()\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"LIGO-H1-GW150914\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 真实数据: {len(strain_real)} samples\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(f\"   ⚠️  gwpy 不可用: {e}\")\n    print(\"   → 使用模拟彩色高斯噪声\")\n    n_samples = FS * DURATION\n    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n_samples, d=1.0/FS)\n    psd_model = np.ones_like(freqs) * 1e-46\n    mask = freqs > 0\n    psd_model[mask] = 1e-46 * ((freqs[mask]/100)**(-4.14) + 5.0*(1+(freqs[mask]/100)**2))\n    amplitudes = np.sqrt(psd_model * FS / 2)\n    phases = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n    strain_real = np.fft.irfft(amplitudes * np.exp(1j*phases), n=n_samples)\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"SIMULATED-aLIGO-NOISE\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 模拟数据: {len(strain_real)} samples\")\n\n# ── 2. LER 核心函数 ──\ndef estimate_noise_psd(data, fs):\n    nperseg = min(len(data)//4, fs*4)\n    return sp_signal.welch(data, fs=fs, nperseg=nperseg, noverlap=nperseg//2, window='hann')\n\ndef whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values):\n    n = len(data)\n    data_fft = fft(data)\n    freqs_fft = fftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    psd_interp = np.interp(np.abs(freqs_fft), psd_freqs, psd_values,\n                           left=psd_values[0], right=psd_values[-1])\n    psd_interp = np.maximum(psd_interp, 1e-60)\n    return np.real(ifft(data_fft / np.sqrt(psd_interp * fs / 2)))\n\ndef null_code_length(data):\n    n = len(data)\n    sigma2 = max(np.var(data), 1e-30)\n    return (n/2.0) * np.log2(2*np.pi*np.e*sigma2)\n\ndef mdl_search(data, fs, max_k=50, f_low=20, f_high=1000):\n    n = len(data)\n    lam = 0.5*np.log2(n) if LAMBDA_BIC is None else LAMBDA_BIC\n    freqs_pos = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    mask = (freqs_pos>=f_low)&(freqs_pos<=f_high)\n    t = np.arange(n)/fs\n    residual = data.copy()\n    best_mdl = null_code_length(data)\n    best_K = 0\n    components = []\n    for k in range(1, max_k+1):\n        res_fft = np.fft.rfft(residual)\n        res_power = np.abs(res_fft)**2/n\n        res_power[~mask] = 0\n        peak_idx = np.argmax(res_power)\n        peak_freq = freqs_pos[peak_idx]\n        peak_amp = 2*np.abs(res_fft[peak_idx])/n\n        peak_phase = np.angle(res_fft[peak_idx])\n        if peak_amp < 1e-30: break\n        component = peak_amp*np.sin(2*np.pi*peak_freq*t+peak_phase)\n        residual -= component\n        components.append((peak_freq, peak_amp, peak_phase))\n        sigma2_res = max(np.var(residual), 1e-30)\n        mdl_total = (n/2.0)*np.log2(2*np.pi*np.e*sigma2_res) + lam*3*k\n        if mdl_total < best_mdl:\n            best_mdl = mdl_total; best_K = k\n        else:\n            residual += component; components.pop(); break\n    return best_mdl, best_K, components, residual\n\ndef compute_ler(data, fs, f_low=20, f_high=1000):\n    psd_freqs, psd_values = estimate_noise_psd(data, fs)\n    whitened = whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values)\n    null_bits = null_code_length(whitened)\n    mdl_bits, n_components, components, residual = mdl_search(whitened, fs, f_low=f_low, f_high=f_high)\n    return {'ler': null_bits-mdl_bits, 'null_bits': null_bits, 'mdl_bits': mdl_bits,\n            'n_components': n_components, 'whitened': whitened, 'residual': residual}\n\n# ── 3. Stage 1: 注入实验 ──\nprint(\"\\n🔬 Stage 1: 注入实验...\")\n\ndef inject_signal(noise, fs, omega_alpha=1e-7, alpha=2/3, f_ref=25):\n    n = len(noise)\n    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs); freqs[0]=1e-10\n    H0 = 2.2e-18\n    S_h = (3*H0**2)/(2*np.pi**2) * omega_alpha*(freqs/f_ref)**alpha / freqs**3\n    amplitudes = np.sqrt(S_h*fs/2)\n    phases = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n    signal = np.fft.irfft(amplitudes*np.exp(1j*phases), n=n)\n    return noise+signal\n\nomega_values = np.logspace(-9, -5, 15)\nn_trials = 5\nresults_injection = []\n\nfor i, omega in enumerate(omega_values):\n    ler_vals = []\n    for trial in range(n_trials):\n        np.random.seed(SEED+trial*1000+i)\n        injected = inject_signal(strain_real, FS, omega_alpha=omega)\n        r = compute_ler(injected, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n        ler_vals.append(r['ler'])\n    results_injection.append({'omega':omega,'ler_mean':np.mean(ler_vals),'ler_std':np.std(ler_vals),'ler_values':ler_vals})\n    print(f\"   [{i+1:2d}/{len(omega_values)}] Ω={omega:.1e}  LER={np.mean(ler_vals):.1f}±{np.std(ler_vals):.1f} bits\")\n\nprint(\"\\n   计算纯噪声基线...\")\nler_noise_only = []\nfor trial in range(n_trials*3):\n    np.random.seed(SEED+99999+trial)\n    r = compute_ler(strain_real, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_noise_only.append(r['ler'])\nnoise_baseline = np.mean(ler_noise_only)\nnoise_std = np.std(ler_noise_only)\nthreshold_3sigma = noise_baseline + 3*noise_std\nprint(f\"   基线: {noise_baseline:.2f} ± {noise_std:.2f} bits  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\n\n# ── 4. Stage 2 预览: LER 时间滑动 ──\nprint(\"\\n🌊 Stage 2 预览: GW150914 LER 时间滑动...\")\nwindow_size = FS*2; step_size = FS//4\nler_ts = []; time_centers = []\nfor start in range(0, len(strain_real)-window_size, step_size):\n    seg = strain_real[start:start+window_size]\n    r = compute_ler(seg, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_ts.append(r['ler']); time_centers.append((start+window_size/2)/FS)\nler_ts = np.array(ler_ts); time_centers = np.array(time_centers)\nevent_t = DURATION/2; peak_idx = np.argmax(ler_ts); peak_t = time_centers[peak_idx]\nprint(f\"   LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  (事件在 {event_t:.1f}s, 偏差 {abs(peak_t-event_t):.2f}s)\")\n\n# ── 5. 可视化 ──\nprint(\"\\n📈 生成图表...\")\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,10))\nfig.suptitle('ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证结果\\n#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')\n\nomegas = [r['omega'] for r in results_injection]\nler_means = [r['ler_mean'] for r in results_injection]\nler_stds  = [r['ler_std']  for r in results_injection]\ndetection_prob = [sum(1 for v in r['ler_values'] if v>threshold_3sigma)/len(r['ler_values']) for r in results_injection]\n\nax=axes[0,0]\nax.errorbar(omegas,ler_means,yerr=ler_stds,fmt='o-',color='royalblue',capsize=3,label='LER mean±std')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma,color='red',ls='--',label=f'3σ={threshold_3sigma:.1f}')\nax.axhline(noise_baseline,color='gray',ls=':',label=f'baseline={noise_baseline:.1f}')\nax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('Injected Ω_α'); ax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(a) Injection Recovery'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[0,1]\nax.plot(time_centers,ler_ts,color='teal',lw=0.8)\nax.axvline(event_t,color='red',ls='--',label=f'GW150914 ({event_t:.1f}s)')\nax.axvline(peak_t,color='orange',ls=':',label=f'LER peak ({peak_t:.2f}s)')\nax.set_xlabel('Time (s)'); ax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(b) Time Slide over GW150914'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[1,0]\nr_full = compute_ler(strain_real,FS,f_low=F_LOW,f_high=F_HIGH)\nax.hist(r_full['whitened'],bins=100,density=True,alpha=0.7,color='steelblue',label='Whitened')\nxg=np.linspace(-5,5,200); ax.plot(xg,np.exp(-xg**2/2)/np.sqrt(2*np.pi),'r-',lw=2,label='N(0,1)')\nax.set_xlabel('Amplitude'); ax.set_ylabel('Density')\nax.set_title('(c) Whitened Data vs Gaussian'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_xlim(-5,5); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[1,1]\nax.plot(omegas,detection_prob,'s-',color='darkgreen',markersize=6)\nax.axhline(0.5,color='gray',ls=':',label='50%'); ax.axhline(0.9,color='orange',ls=':',label='90%')\nax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('Injected Ω_α'); ax.set_ylabel('Detection Prob.')\nax.set_title('(d) Detection Efficiency (3σ)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(-0.05,1.05); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nplt.tight_layout()\noutput_file='shangmeng_ler_stage1_results.png'\nplt.savefig(output_file,dpi=200,bbox_inches='tight')\nprint(f\"   ✅ 图表: {output_file}\")\n\n# ── 6. 汇总报告 ──\nprint(\"\\n\"+\"=\"*60)\nprint(\"📋 Stage 1 实验报告\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\nprint(f\"数据来源: {DATA_SOURCE} | FS={FS}Hz | {DURATION}s | [{F_LOW}-{F_HIGH}]Hz\")\nprint(f\"基线 LER: {noise_baseline:.2f}±{noise_std:.2f}  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\nprint(f\"\\n── 注入恢复 ──\")\nfor r,prob in zip(results_injection,detection_prob):\n    flag='✅' if r['ler_mean']>threshold_3sigma else '  '\n    bar='█'*int(prob*20)+'░'*(20-int(prob*20))\n    print(f\"{flag} Ω={r['omega']:.1e}  LER={r['ler_mean']:.1f}±{r['ler_std']:.1f}  [{bar}] {prob*100:.0f}%\")\nprint(f\"\\n── GW150914 Stage 2 预览 ──\")\nprint(f\"LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  |  偏差: {abs(peak_t-event_t):.2f}s\")\nif abs(peak_t-event_t)<1.0: print(\"✅ LER峰值与合并时刻一致\")\nelse: print(\"⚠️  峰值偏移较大，需进一步分析\")\nprint(\"\\n🌌 Stage 1 验证完成\")\nprint(\"#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0\")\nprint(\"#CONFIRM🌌9622-ONLY-ONCE🧬LK9X-772Z\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n","numLines":226,"startLine":1,"totalLines":226}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d5a3c621-7251-4b16-85ef-dfa213586905"}

> {"parentUuid":"031785c6-560d-4c98-994d-df8a4cc281ff","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system/CNSH-gitee/docs/papers/shangmeng-ler/src","sessionId":"e807b45c-95ed-41ae-a1c6-3b6ed92b8093","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-256eac70508efd36","slug":"dynamic-swimming-otter","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01Ffjwr7kiRa2SXcMqVG9R3L","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019AW7c8TxmQPSbhcGQ4YVrE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system/CNSH-gitee/docs/papers/shangmeng-ler/src/shangmeng_ler_stage1.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证脚本 v1.1（修复版）\nDNA: #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\nAuthor: Lucky (Zhuge Xin) · UID9622 × Claude (Anthropic PBC)\nLicense: MulanPSL v2.0\n\n修复说明 v1.1:\n- Stage 1 改为 CW正弦注入（MDL正弦搜索的正确应用场景）\n- SGWB随机背景检测需两探测器互相关（属于 Stage 3）\n- PSD从独立噪声参考段估计，避免\"自消\"效应\n- 增加 debug 模式，打印中间量排查问题\n\"\"\"\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import signal as sp_signal\nfrom scipy.fft import fft, ifft, fftfreq\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport warnings\nwarnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n\nFS = 4096          # 采样率 Hz\nDURATION = 32      # 总时长 s\nF_LOW  = 20        # 带通低端 Hz\nF_HIGH = 1000      # 带通高端 Hz\nLAMBDA_BIC = None  # None → BIC: 0.5*log2(n)\nSEED = 9622\n\nnp.random.seed(SEED)\n\nprint(\"=\"*60)\nprint(\"🌌 ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证 v1.1（修复版）\")\nprint(\"   CW正弦注入 × MDL检测 × 独立噪声参考\")\nprint(\"   #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n\n# ── 1. 数据获取 ──────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n📡 Phase 1: 获取 LIGO 数据...\")\ntry:\n    from gwpy.timeseries import TimeSeries\n    GPS_EVENT = 1126259462.4          # GW150914 合并时刻\n    # 取 64s 数据：前 32s 噪声参考 / 后 32s 注入测试\n    GPS_START = int(GPS_EVENT) - 48\n    GPS_END   = int(GPS_EVENT) + 16\n    print(f\"   下载 H1 strain: GPS [{GPS_START}, {GPS_END}]  (64s)\")\n    h1_raw = TimeSeries.fetch_open_data('H1', GPS_START, GPS_END, sample_rate=FS)\n    strain_all = h1_raw.value.copy()\n    n_total = len(strain_all)\n    half = n_total // 2\n    strain_ref  = strain_all[:half]   # 噪声参考段（无事件）\n    strain_test = strain_all[half:]   # 测试段（含GW150914）\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"LIGO-H1-GW150914\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 真实数据: 总 {n_total} samples | 参考 {len(strain_ref)} | 测试 {len(strain_test)}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(f\"   ⚠️  gwpy 不可用: {e}\")\n    print(\"   → 使用模拟彩色高斯噪声\")\n    n_samples = FS * DURATION\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)\n\n    def make_colored_noise(n, fs, seed=None):\n        rng2 = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n        freqs[0] = 1e-10\n        # aLIGO-like PSD\n        psd = 1e-46 * ((freqs/100)**(-4.14) + 5*(1+(freqs/100)**2))\n        amps = np.sqrt(psd * fs / 2)\n        phases = rng2.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n        return np.fft.irfft(amps * np.exp(1j*phases), n=n)\n\n    strain_ref  = make_colored_noise(n_samples, FS, seed=SEED)\n    strain_test = make_colored_noise(n_samples, FS, seed=SEED+1)\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"SIMULATED-aLIGO-NOISE\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 模拟数据: 参考 {len(strain_ref)} | 测试 {len(strain_test)}\")\n\n# ── 2. LER 核心函数 ──────────────────────────────────────\ndef estimate_noise_psd(data, fs):\n    nperseg = min(len(data)//4, fs*4)\n    return sp_signal.welch(data, fs=fs, nperseg=nperseg,\n                           noverlap=nperseg//2, window='hann')\n\ndef whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values):\n    n = len(data)\n    data_fft = fft(data)\n    freqs_fft = fftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    psd_interp = np.interp(np.abs(freqs_fft), psd_freqs, psd_values,\n                           left=psd_values[0], right=psd_values[-1])\n    psd_interp = np.maximum(psd_interp, 1e-60)\n    whitened = np.real(ifft(data_fft / np.sqrt(psd_interp * fs / 2)))\n    # 确保均值为零\n    whitened -= whitened.mean()\n    return whitened\n\ndef null_code_length(data):\n    n = len(data)\n    sigma2 = max(np.var(data), 1e-30)\n    return (n / 2.0) * np.log2(2 * np.pi * np.e * sigma2)\n\ndef mdl_search(data, fs, max_k=80, f_low=20, f_high=1000, debug=False):\n    \"\"\"\n    贪心MDL正弦搜索。\n    在带通 [f_low, f_high] 内逐步提取最强正弦分量，\n    直到 MDL 不再减小为止。\n\n    Returns: (best_mdl, best_K, components, residual)\n    \"\"\"\n    n = len(data)\n    lam = 0.5 * np.log2(n) if LAMBDA_BIC is None else LAMBDA_BIC\n    freqs_pos = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    mask = (freqs_pos >= f_low) & (freqs_pos <= f_high)\n    t = np.arange(n) / fs\n\n    residual = data.copy()\n    null_bits = null_code_length(data)\n    best_mdl = null_bits\n    best_K = 0\n    components = []\n\n    if debug:\n        print(f\"      [MDL] n={n}, λ={lam:.2f}, null_bits={null_bits:.2f}\")\n\n    for k in range(1, max_k + 1):\n        res_fft = np.fft.rfft(residual)\n        res_power = np.abs(res_fft)**2\n        res_power_masked = res_power.copy()\n        res_power_masked[~mask] = 0\n\n        peak_idx = np.argmax(res_power_masked)\n        peak_freq = freqs_pos[peak_idx]\n        # 正确的幅度估计（双边 FFT → rfft 补偿 ×2，除以 n）\n        peak_amp = 2 * np.abs(res_fft[peak_idx]) / n\n        peak_phase = np.angle(res_fft[peak_idx])\n\n        if peak_amp < 1e-30:\n            break\n\n        component = peak_amp * np.cos(2 * np.pi * peak_freq * t + peak_phase)\n        residual -= component\n        components.append((peak_freq, peak_amp, peak_phase))\n\n        sigma2_res = max(np.var(residual), 1e-30)\n        # MDL = 残差编码长度 + 参数惩罚（每个正弦 3 个参数：freq, amp, phase）\n        mdl_total = (n / 2.0) * np.log2(2 * np.pi * np.e * sigma2_res) + lam * 3 * k\n\n        if debug and k <= 5:\n            print(f\"      [MDL k={k}] f={peak_freq:.1f}Hz A={peak_amp:.4f} \"\n                  f\"σ²={sigma2_res:.4f} mdl={mdl_total:.2f} best={best_mdl:.2f}\")\n\n        if mdl_total < best_mdl:\n            best_mdl = mdl_total\n            best_K = k\n        else:\n            # MDL 不再改善 → 回退最后一个分量\n            residual += component\n            components.pop()\n            break\n\n    return best_mdl, best_K, components, residual\n\ndef compute_ler(test_data, ref_data, fs, f_low=20, f_high=1000, debug=False):\n    \"\"\"\n    计算逻辑熵减（LER）。\n\n    ref_data: 独立噪声参考段（用于估计 PSD，避免信号自消）\n    test_data: 待分析段（含可能的注入信号）\n    \"\"\"\n    # 用参考段估计噪声 PSD\n    psd_freqs, psd_values = estimate_noise_psd(ref_data, fs)\n    # 用噪声 PSD 白化测试段\n    whitened = whiten(test_data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values)\n    null_bits = null_code_length(whitened)\n    mdl_bits, n_k, comps, residual = mdl_search(\n        whitened, fs, f_low=f_low, f_high=f_high, debug=debug\n    )\n    ler = null_bits - mdl_bits\n    return {\n        'ler': max(ler, 0.0),\n        'null_bits': null_bits,\n        'mdl_bits': mdl_bits,\n        'n_components': n_k,\n        'whitened': whitened,\n        'residual': residual,\n        'components': comps,\n    }\n\n# ── 3. CW 正弦注入实验 ─────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n🔬 Stage 1: CW 正弦注入实验...\")\nprint(\"   注入确定性正弦信号（MDL正弦搜索的正确应用场景）\")\nprint(\"   参考段独立估计 PSD，避免信号自消\")\n\ndef inject_cw(data, fs, f_inj=150.0, snr_mf=1.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    在 data 中注入 CW 正弦信号。\n\n    snr_mf: 匹配滤波器 SNR (rho)\n    A = rho * sigma * sqrt(2/n)   →  rho = A*sqrt(n/2)/sigma\n\n    在白化后域: sigma≈1, 所以白化后振幅 ≈ rho * sqrt(2/n)\n    \"\"\"\n    n = len(data)\n    t = np.arange(n) / fs\n    sigma = np.std(data)\n    amp = snr_mf * sigma * np.sqrt(2.0 / n)\n    phase0 = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi)\n    return data + amp * np.cos(2*np.pi*f_inj*t + phase0), amp\n\n# 注入频率\nF_INJ = 150.0   # Hz（远离 60Hz 工频线）\n\n# SNR 范围：从几乎不可见到 SNR=30（强信号）\nsnr_values = np.logspace(0, 2.5, 20)   # 1 → ~316\nn_trials = 8\nresults_cw = []\n\nprint(f\"\\n   注入频率: {F_INJ} Hz  |  SNR范围: [{snr_values[0]:.1f}, {snr_values[-1]:.0f}]\")\n\nfor i, snr in enumerate(snr_values):\n    ler_vals = []\n    for trial in range(n_trials):\n        np.random.seed(SEED + trial * 1000 + i)\n        injected, amp = inject_cw(strain_test, FS, f_inj=F_INJ, snr_mf=snr)\n        r = compute_ler(injected, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH,\n                        debug=(i == 0 and trial == 0))\n        ler_vals.append(r['ler'])\n    mean_ler = np.mean(ler_vals)\n    std_ler = np.std(ler_vals)\n    results_cw.append({\n        'snr': snr, 'ler_mean': mean_ler, 'ler_std': std_ler,\n        'ler_values': ler_vals\n    })\n    bar = '█' * min(int(mean_ler / 5), 30)\n    print(f\"   [{i+1:2d}/{len(snr_values)}] SNR={snr:6.1f}  \"\n          f\"LER={mean_ler:7.2f}±{std_ler:.2f}  {bar}\")\n\n# ── 4. 纯噪声基线 ──────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n   计算纯噪声基线（无注入）...\")\nler_noise_only = []\nfor trial in range(n_trials * 3):\n    np.random.seed(SEED + 99999 + trial)\n    r = compute_ler(strain_test, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_noise_only.append(r['ler'])\nnoise_baseline = np.mean(ler_noise_only)\nnoise_std = np.std(ler_noise_only)\nthreshold_3sigma = noise_baseline + 3 * noise_std\nprint(f\"   基线: {noise_baseline:.2f} ± {noise_std:.2f} bits  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\n\n# ── 5. GW150914 时间滑动 ──────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n🌊 Stage 2 预览: GW150914 时间滑动...\")\nWIN = FS * 2     # 2s 窗口\nSTEP = FS // 4   # 0.25s 步长\nler_ts = []\ntime_centers = []\n\nfor start in range(0, len(strain_test) - WIN, STEP):\n    seg = strain_test[start:start + WIN]\n    ref_seg = strain_ref[:WIN]   # 用参考段前 WIN 估计 PSD\n    r = compute_ler(seg, ref_seg, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_ts.append(r['ler'])\n    time_centers.append((start + WIN / 2) / FS)\n\nler_ts = np.array(ler_ts)\ntime_centers = np.array(time_centers)\n\n# GW150914 在 test 段内的相对位置（测试段起点 = GPS_EVENT - 16）\nevent_t_in_test = 16.0   # s from test segment start\npeak_idx = np.argmax(ler_ts)\npeak_t = time_centers[peak_idx]\nprint(f\"   LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  \"\n      f\"(事件在 {event_t_in_test:.1f}s, 偏差 {abs(peak_t - event_t_in_test):.2f}s)\")\n\n# ── 6. 可视化 ──────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n📈 生成图表...\")\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))\nfig.suptitle(\n    'ShangMeng 熵梦 · LER Stage 1 验证结果 v1.1\\n'\n    'CW正弦注入 · 独立噪声参考 · MDL正弦检测\\n'\n    '#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1',\n    fontsize=12, fontweight='bold'\n)\n\nsnrs      = [r['snr']      for r in results_cw]\nler_means = [r['ler_mean'] for r in results_cw]\nler_stds  = [r['ler_std']  for r in results_cw]\ndet_prob  = [\n    sum(1 for v in r['ler_values'] if v > threshold_3sigma) / len(r['ler_values'])\n    for r in results_cw\n]\n\n# (a) LER vs SNR\nax = axes[0, 0]\nax.errorbar(snrs, ler_means, yerr=ler_stds, fmt='o-',\n            color='royalblue', capsize=3, label='LER mean±std')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma, color='red', ls='--',\n           label=f'3σ 阈值={threshold_3sigma:.1f}')\nax.axhline(noise_baseline, color='gray', ls=':',\n           label=f'噪声基线={noise_baseline:.1f}')\nax.set_xscale('log')\nax.set_xlabel('Matched-Filter SNR (ρ)')\nax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title(f'(a) CW注入恢复  f_inj={F_INJ}Hz')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (b) 时间滑动\nax = axes[0, 1]\nax.plot(time_centers, ler_ts, color='teal', lw=0.8, label='LER')\nax.axvline(event_t_in_test, color='red', ls='--',\n           label=f'GW150914 ({event_t_in_test:.1f}s)')\nax.axvline(peak_t, color='orange', ls=':',\n           label=f'LER峰值 ({peak_t:.2f}s)')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma, color='gray', ls=':', lw=0.8, label='3σ')\nax.set_xlabel('Time in Test Segment (s)')\nax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(b) GW150914 时间滑动')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (c) 白化数据分布\nax = axes[1, 0]\nr_demo = compute_ler(strain_test, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\nax.hist(r_demo['whitened'], bins=100, density=True,\n        alpha=0.7, color='steelblue', label='白化后')\nxg = np.linspace(-5, 5, 200)\nax.plot(xg, np.exp(-xg**2/2)/np.sqrt(2*np.pi), 'r-', lw=2, label='N(0,1)')\nax.set_xlabel('Amplitude')\nax.set_ylabel('Density')\nax.set_title('(c) 白化后数据 vs 高斯分布')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.set_xlim(-5, 5)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (d) 检测效率\nax = axes[1, 1]\nax.plot(snrs, det_prob, 's-', color='darkgreen', markersize=6)\nax.axhline(0.5,  color='gray',   ls=':', label='50%')\nax.axhline(0.9,  color='orange', ls=':', label='90%')\n# 标注 SNR_50 和 SNR_90\nif any(p >= 0.5 for p in det_prob):\n    snr50 = snrs[[i for i, p in enumerate(det_prob) if p >= 0.5][0]]\n    ax.axvline(snr50, color='gray', ls='--', lw=0.8, label=f'SNR50={snr50:.1f}')\nif any(p >= 0.9 for p in det_prob):\n    snr90 = snrs[[i for i, p in enumerate(det_prob) if p >= 0.9][0]]\n    ax.axvline(snr90, color='orange', ls='--', lw=0.8, label=f'SNR90={snr90:.1f}')\nax.set_xscale('log')\nax.set_xlabel('Matched-Filter SNR (ρ)')\nax.set_ylabel('Detection Prob. event_t_in_test) < 2.0:\n    print(\"✅ LER峰值与合并时刻一致（2s内）\")\nelse:\n    print(\"⚠️  峰值偏移较大，需进一步分析\")\n\n# 找检测阈值 SNR\nsnr_50 = next((r['snr'] for r, p in zip(results_cw, det_prob) if p >= 0.5), None)\nsnr_90 = next((r['snr'] for r, p in zip(results_cw, det_prob) if p >= 0.9), None)\nprint(f\"\\n── 灵敏度指标 ──\")\nif snr_50: print(f\"SNR_50 (50%检测率): {snr_50:.1f}\")\nif snr_90: print(f\"SNR_90 (90%检测率): {snr_90:.1f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n🌌 Stage 1 验证完成\")\nprint(\"#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\")\nprint(\"#CONFIRM🌌9622-ONLY-ONCE🧬LK9X-772Z\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":15322,"cache_read_input_tokens":25094,"output_tokens":11139,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":15322,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"}},"requestId":"req_011CYtC4fyRwoyupRA23MzyR","type":"assistant","uuid":"963e56a1-49b8-4903-8f8e-2c752b957ca1","timestamp":"2026-03-09T21:12:29.278Z"}

> {"parentUuid":"963e56a1-49b8-4903-8f8e-2c752b957ca1","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system/CNSH-gitee/docs/papers/shangmeng-ler/src","sessionId":"e807b45c-95ed-41ae-a1c6-3b6ed92b8093","version":"2.1.70","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acompact-256eac70508efd36","slug":"dynamic-swimming-otter","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019AW7c8TxmQPSbhcGQ4YVrE","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system/CNSH-gitee/docs/papers/shangmeng-ler/src/shangmeng_ler_stage1.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"51f8c1e3-ba0b-4199-851c-ac4281aadf6e","timestamp":"2026-03-09T21:12:29.302Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"update","filePath":"/Users/zuimeidedeyihan/longhun-system/CNSH-gitee/docs/papers/shangmeng-ler/src/shangmeng_ler_stage1.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证脚本 v1.1（修复版）\nDNA: #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\nAuthor: Lucky (Zhuge Xin) · UID9622 × Claude (Anthropic PBC)\nLicense: MulanPSL v2.0\n\n修复说明 v1.1:\n- Stage 1 改为 CW正弦注入（MDL正弦搜索的正确应用场景）\n- SGWB随机背景检测需两探测器互相关（属于 Stage 3）\n- PSD从独立噪声参考段估计，避免\"自消\"效应\n- 增加 debug 模式，打印中间量排查问题\n\"\"\"\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import signal as sp_signal\nfrom scipy.fft import fft, ifft, fftfreq\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport warnings\nwarnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n\nFS = 4096          # 采样率 Hz\nDURATION = 32      # 总时长 s\nF_LOW  = 20        # 带通低端 Hz\nF_HIGH = 1000      # 带通高端 Hz\nLAMBDA_BIC = None  # None → BIC: 0.5*log2(n)\nSEED = 9622\n\nnp.random.seed(SEED)\n\nprint(\"=\"*60)\nprint(\"🌌 ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证 v1.1（修复版）\")\nprint(\"   CW正弦注入 × MDL检测 × 独立噪声参考\")\nprint(\"   #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n\n# ── 1. 数据获取 ──────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n📡 Phase 1: 获取 LIGO 数据...\")\ntry:\n    from gwpy.timeseries import TimeSeries\n    GPS_EVENT = 1126259462.4          # GW150914 合并时刻\n    # 取 64s 数据：前 32s 噪声参考 / 后 32s 注入测试\n    GPS_START = int(GPS_EVENT) - 48\n    GPS_END   = int(GPS_EVENT) + 16\n    print(f\"   下载 H1 strain: GPS [{GPS_START}, {GPS_END}]  (64s)\")\n    h1_raw = TimeSeries.fetch_open_data('H1', GPS_START, GPS_END, sample_rate=FS)\n    strain_all = h1_raw.value.copy()\n    n_total = len(strain_all)\n    half = n_total // 2\n    strain_ref  = strain_all[:half]   # 噪声参考段（无事件）\n    strain_test = strain_all[half:]   # 测试段（含GW150914）\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"LIGO-H1-GW150914\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 真实数据: 总 {n_total} samples | 参考 {len(strain_ref)} | 测试 {len(strain_test)}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(f\"   ⚠️  gwpy 不可用: {e}\")\n    print(\"   → 使用模拟彩色高斯噪声\")\n    n_samples = FS * DURATION\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)\n\n    def make_colored_noise(n, fs, seed=None):\n        rng2 = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n        freqs[0] = 1e-10\n        # aLIGO-like PSD\n        psd = 1e-46 * ((freqs/100)**(-4.14) + 5*(1+(freqs/100)**2))\n        amps = np.sqrt(psd * fs / 2)\n        phases = rng2.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n        return np.fft.irfft(amps * np.exp(1j*phases), n=n)\n\n    strain_ref  = make_colored_noise(n_samples, FS, seed=SEED)\n    strain_test = make_colored_noise(n_samples, FS, seed=SEED+1)\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"SIMULATED-aLIGO-NOISE\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 模拟数据: 参考 {len(strain_ref)} | 测试 {len(strain_test)}\")\n\n# ── 2. LER 核心函数 ──────────────────────────────────────\ndef estimate_noise_psd(data, fs):\n    nperseg = min(len(data)//4, fs*4)\n    return sp_signal.welch(data, fs=fs, nperseg=nperseg,\n                           noverlap=nperseg//2, window='hann')\n\ndef whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values):\n    n = len(data)\n    data_fft = fft(data)\n    freqs_fft = fftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    psd_interp = np.interp(np.abs(freqs_fft), psd_freqs, psd_values,\n                           left=psd_values[0], right=psd_values[-1])\n    psd_interp = np.maximum(psd_interp, 1e-60)\n    whitened = np.real(ifft(data_fft / np.sqrt(psd_interp * fs / 2)))\n    # 确保均值为零\n    whitened -= whitened.mean()\n    return whitened\n\ndef null_code_length(data):\n    n = len(data)\n    sigma2 = max(np.var(data), 1e-30)\n    return (n / 2.0) * np.log2(2 * np.pi * np.e * sigma2)\n\ndef mdl_search(data, fs, max_k=80, f_low=20, f_high=1000, debug=False):\n    \"\"\"\n    贪心MDL正弦搜索。\n    在带通 [f_low, f_high] 内逐步提取最强正弦分量，\n    直到 MDL 不再减小为止。\n\n    Returns: (best_mdl, best_K, components, residual)\n    \"\"\"\n    n = len(data)\n    lam = 0.5 * np.log2(n) if LAMBDA_BIC is None else LAMBDA_BIC\n    freqs_pos = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    mask = (freqs_pos >= f_low) & (freqs_pos <= f_high)\n    t = np.arange(n) / fs\n\n    residual = data.copy()\n    null_bits = null_code_length(data)\n    best_mdl = null_bits\n    best_K = 0\n    components = []\n\n    if debug:\n        print(f\"      [MDL] n={n}, λ={lam:.2f}, null_bits={null_bits:.2f}\")\n\n    for k in range(1, max_k + 1):\n        res_fft = np.fft.rfft(residual)\n        res_power = np.abs(res_fft)**2\n        res_power_masked = res_power.copy()\n        res_power_masked[~mask] = 0\n\n        peak_idx = np.argmax(res_power_masked)\n        peak_freq = freqs_pos[peak_idx]\n        # 正确的幅度估计（双边 FFT → rfft 补偿 ×2，除以 n）\n        peak_amp = 2 * np.abs(res_fft[peak_idx]) / n\n        peak_phase = np.angle(res_fft[peak_idx])\n\n        if peak_amp < 1e-30:\n            break\n\n        component = peak_amp * np.cos(2 * np.pi * peak_freq * t + peak_phase)\n        residual -= component\n        components.append((peak_freq, peak_amp, peak_phase))\n\n        sigma2_res = max(np.var(residual), 1e-30)\n        # MDL = 残差编码长度 + 参数惩罚（每个正弦 3 个参数：freq, amp, phase）\n        mdl_total = (n / 2.0) * np.log2(2 * np.pi * np.e * sigma2_res) + lam * 3 * k\n\n        if debug and k <= 5:\n            print(f\"      [MDL k={k}] f={peak_freq:.1f}Hz A={peak_amp:.4f} \"\n                  f\"σ²={sigma2_res:.4f} mdl={mdl_total:.2f} best={best_mdl:.2f}\")\n\n        if mdl_total < best_mdl:\n            best_mdl = mdl_total\n            best_K = k\n        else:\n            # MDL 不再改善 → 回退最后一个分量\n            residual += component\n            components.pop()\n            break\n\n    return best_mdl, best_K, components, residual\n\ndef compute_ler(test_data, ref_data, fs, f_low=20, f_high=1000, debug=False):\n    \"\"\"\n    计算逻辑熵减（LER）。\n\n    ref_data: 独立噪声参考段（用于估计 PSD，避免信号自消）\n    test_data: 待分析段（含可能的注入信号）\n    \"\"\"\n    # 用参考段估计噪声 PSD\n    psd_freqs, psd_values = estimate_noise_psd(ref_data, fs)\n    # 用噪声 PSD 白化测试段\n    whitened = whiten(test_data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values)\n    null_bits = null_code_length(whitened)\n    mdl_bits, n_k, comps, residual = mdl_search(\n        whitened, fs, f_low=f_low, f_high=f_high, debug=debug\n    )\n    ler = null_bits - mdl_bits\n    return {\n        'ler': max(ler, 0.0),\n        'null_bits': null_bits,\n        'mdl_bits': mdl_bits,\n        'n_components': n_k,\n        'whitened': whitened,\n        'residual': residual,\n        'components': comps,\n    }\n\n# ── 3. CW 正弦注入实验 ─────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n🔬 Stage 1: CW 正弦注入实验...\")\nprint(\"   注入确定性正弦信号（MDL正弦搜索的正确应用场景）\")\nprint(\"   参考段独立估计 PSD，避免信号自消\")\n\ndef inject_cw(data, fs, f_inj=150.0, snr_mf=1.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    在 data 中注入 CW 正弦信号。\n\n    snr_mf: 匹配滤波器 SNR (rho)\n    A = rho * sigma * sqrt(2/n)   →  rho = A*sqrt(n/2)/sigma\n\n    在白化后域: sigma≈1, 所以白化后振幅 ≈ rho * sqrt(2/n)\n    \"\"\"\n    n = len(data)\n    t = np.arange(n) / fs\n    sigma = np.std(data)\n    amp = snr_mf * sigma * np.sqrt(2.0 / n)\n    phase0 = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi)\n    return data + amp * np.cos(2*np.pi*f_inj*t + phase0), amp\n\n# 注入频率\nF_INJ = 150.0   # Hz（远离 60Hz 工频线）\n\n# SNR 范围：从几乎不可见到 SNR=30（强信号）\nsnr_values = np.logspace(0, 2.5, 20)   # 1 → ~316\nn_trials = 8\nresults_cw = []\n\nprint(f\"\\n   注入频率: {F_INJ} Hz  |  SNR范围: [{snr_values[0]:.1f}, {snr_values[-1]:.0f}]\")\n\nfor i, snr in enumerate(snr_values):\n    ler_vals = []\n    for trial in range(n_trials):\n        np.random.seed(SEED + trial * 1000 + i)\n        injected, amp = inject_cw(strain_test, FS, f_inj=F_INJ, snr_mf=snr)\n        r = compute_ler(injected, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH,\n                        debug=(i == 0 and trial == 0))\n        ler_vals.append(r['ler'])\n    mean_ler = np.mean(ler_vals)\n    std_ler = np.std(ler_vals)\n    results_cw.append({\n        'snr': snr, 'ler_mean': mean_ler, 'ler_std': std_ler,\n        'ler_values': ler_vals\n    })\n    bar = '█' * min(int(mean_ler / 5), 30)\n    print(f\"   [{i+1:2d}/{len(snr_values)}] SNR={snr:6.1f}  \"\n          f\"LER={mean_ler:7.2f}±{std_ler:.2f}  {bar}\")\n\n# ── 4. 纯噪声基线 ──────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n   计算纯噪声基线（无注入）...\")\nler_noise_only = []\nfor trial in range(n_trials * 3):\n    np.random.seed(SEED + 99999 + trial)\n    r = compute_ler(strain_test, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_noise_only.append(r['ler'])\nnoise_baseline = np.mean(ler_noise_only)\nnoise_std = np.std(ler_noise_only)\nthreshold_3sigma = noise_baseline + 3 * noise_std\nprint(f\"   基线: {noise_baseline:.2f} ± {noise_std:.2f} bits  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\n\n# ── 5. GW150914 时间滑动 ──────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n🌊 Stage 2 预览: GW150914 时间滑动...\")\nWIN = FS * 2     # 2s 窗口\nSTEP = FS // 4   # 0.25s 步长\nler_ts = []\ntime_centers = []\n\nfor start in range(0, len(strain_test) - WIN, STEP):\n    seg = strain_test[start:start + WIN]\n    ref_seg = strain_ref[:WIN]   # 用参考段前 WIN 估计 PSD\n    r = compute_ler(seg, ref_seg, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_ts.append(r['ler'])\n    time_centers.append((start + WIN / 2) / FS)\n\nler_ts = np.array(ler_ts)\ntime_centers = np.array(time_centers)\n\n# GW150914 在 test 段内的相对位置（测试段起点 = GPS_EVENT - 16）\nevent_t_in_test = 16.0   # s from test segment start\npeak_idx = np.argmax(ler_ts)\npeak_t = time_centers[peak_idx]\nprint(f\"   LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  \"\n      f\"(事件在 {event_t_in_test:.1f}s, 偏差 {abs(peak_t - event_t_in_test):.2f}s)\")\n\n# ── 6. 可视化 ──────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"\\n📈 生成图表...\")\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))\nfig.suptitle(\n    'ShangMeng 熵梦 · LER Stage 1 验证结果 v1.1\\n'\n    'CW正弦注入 · 独立噪声参考 · MDL正弦检测\\n'\n    '#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1',\n    fontsize=12, fontweight='bold'\n)\n\nsnrs      = [r['snr']      for r in results_cw]\nler_means = [r['ler_mean'] for r in results_cw]\nler_stds  = [r['ler_std']  for r in results_cw]\ndet_prob  = [\n    sum(1 for v in r['ler_values'] if v > threshold_3sigma) / len(r['ler_values'])\n    for r in results_cw\n]\n\n# (a) LER vs SNR\nax = axes[0, 0]\nax.errorbar(snrs, ler_means, yerr=ler_stds, fmt='o-',\n            color='royalblue', capsize=3, label='LER mean±std')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma, color='red', ls='--',\n           label=f'3σ 阈值={threshold_3sigma:.1f}')\nax.axhline(noise_baseline, color='gray', ls=':',\n           label=f'噪声基线={noise_baseline:.1f}')\nax.set_xscale('log')\nax.set_xlabel('Matched-Filter SNR (ρ)')\nax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title(f'(a) CW注入恢复  f_inj={F_INJ}Hz')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (b) 时间滑动\nax = axes[0, 1]\nax.plot(time_centers, ler_ts, color='teal', lw=0.8, label='LER')\nax.axvline(event_t_in_test, color='red', ls='--',\n           label=f'GW150914 ({event_t_in_test:.1f}s)')\nax.axvline(peak_t, color='orange', ls=':',\n           label=f'LER峰值 ({peak_t:.2f}s)')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma, color='gray', ls=':', lw=0.8, label='3σ')\nax.set_xlabel('Time in Test Segment (s)')\nax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(b) GW150914 时间滑动')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (c) 白化数据分布\nax = axes[1, 0]\nr_demo = compute_ler(strain_test, strain_ref, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\nax.hist(r_demo['whitened'], bins=100, density=True,\n        alpha=0.7, color='steelblue', label='白化后')\nxg = np.linspace(-5, 5, 200)\nax.plot(xg, np.exp(-xg**2/2)/np.sqrt(2*np.pi), 'r-', lw=2, label='N(0,1)')\nax.set_xlabel('Amplitude')\nax.set_ylabel('Density')\nax.set_title('(c) 白化后数据 vs 高斯分布')\nax.legend(fontsize=8)\nax.set_xlim(-5, 5)\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\n# (d) 检测效率\nax = axes[1, 1]\nax.plot(snrs, det_prob, 's-', color='darkgreen', markersize=6)\nax.axhline(0.5,  color='gray',   ls=':', label='50%')\nax.axhline(0.9,  color='orange', ls=':', label='90%')\n# 标注 SNR_50 和 SNR_90\nif any(p >= 0.5 for p in det_prob):\n    snr50 = snrs[[i for i, p in enumerate(det_prob) if p >= 0.5][0]]\n    ax.axvline(snr50, color='gray', ls='--', lw=0.8, label=f'SNR50={snr50:.1f}')\nif event_t_in_test) < 2.0:","+    print(\"✅ LER峰值与合并时刻一致（2s内）\")","+else:","+    print(\"⚠️  峰值偏移较大，需进一步分析\")","+","+# 找检测阈值 SNR","+snr_50 = next((r['snr'] for r, p in zip(results_cw, det_prob) if p >= 0.5), None)","+snr_90 = next((r['snr'] for r, p in zip(results_cw, det_prob) if p >= 0.9), None)","+print(f\"\\n── 灵敏度指标 ──\")","+if snr_50: print(f\"SNR_50 (50%检测率): {snr_50:.1f}\")","+if snr_90: print(f\"SNR_90 (90%检测率): {snr_90:.1f}\")","+"," print(\"\\n🌌 Stage 1 验证完成\")","-print(\"#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0\")","+print(\"#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.1\")"," print(\"#CONFIRM🌌9622-ONLY-ONCE🧬LK9X-772Z\")"," print(\"=\"*60)"]}],"originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证脚本\nDNA: #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0\nAuthor: Lucky (Zhuge Xin) · UID9622 × Claude (Anthropic PBC)\nLicense: MulanPSL v2.0\n\"\"\"\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import signal as sp_signal\nfrom scipy.fft import fft, ifft, fftfreq\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport warnings\nwarnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n\nFS = 4096\nDURATION = 32\nF_LOW = 20\nF_HIGH = 1000\nLAMBDA_BIC = None\nSEED = 9622\n\nnp.random.seed(SEED)\n\nprint(\"=\"*60)\nprint(\"🌌 ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证\")\nprint(\"   Turning the Dream of Order out of the Nightmare of Entropy\")\nprint(\"   #龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n\n# ── 1. 数据获取 ──\nprint(\"\\n📡 Phase 1: 获取 LIGO 数据...\")\ntry:\n    from gwpy.timeseries import TimeSeries\n    GPS_EVENT = 1126259462.4\n    GPS_START = int(GPS_EVENT) - 16\n    GPS_END   = int(GPS_EVENT) + 16\n    print(f\"   下载 H1 strain: GPS [{GPS_START}, {GPS_END}]\")\n    h1_data = TimeSeries.fetch_open_data('H1', GPS_START, GPS_END, sample_rate=FS)\n    strain_real = h1_data.value.copy()\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"LIGO-H1-GW150914\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 真实数据: {len(strain_real)} samples\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(f\"   ⚠️  gwpy 不可用: {e}\")\n    print(\"   → 使用模拟彩色高斯噪声\")\n    n_samples = FS * DURATION\n    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n_samples, d=1.0/FS)\n    psd_model = np.ones_like(freqs) * 1e-46\n    mask = freqs > 0\n    psd_model[mask] = 1e-46 * ((freqs[mask]/100)**(-4.14) + 5.0*(1+(freqs[mask]/100)**2))\n    amplitudes = np.sqrt(psd_model * FS / 2)\n    phases = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n    strain_real = np.fft.irfft(amplitudes * np.exp(1j*phases), n=n_samples)\n    DATA_SOURCE = \"SIMULATED-aLIGO-NOISE\"\n    print(f\"   ✅ 模拟数据: {len(strain_real)} samples\")\n\n# ── 2. LER 核心函数 ──\ndef estimate_noise_psd(data, fs):\n    nperseg = min(len(data)//4, fs*4)\n    return sp_signal.welch(data, fs=fs, nperseg=nperseg, noverlap=nperseg//2, window='hann')\n\ndef whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values):\n    n = len(data)\n    data_fft = fft(data)\n    freqs_fft = fftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    psd_interp = np.interp(np.abs(freqs_fft), psd_freqs, psd_values,\n                           left=psd_values[0], right=psd_values[-1])\n    psd_interp = np.maximum(psd_interp, 1e-60)\n    return np.real(ifft(data_fft / np.sqrt(psd_interp * fs / 2)))\n\ndef null_code_length(data):\n    n = len(data)\n    sigma2 = max(np.var(data), 1e-30)\n    return (n/2.0) * np.log2(2*np.pi*np.e*sigma2)\n\ndef mdl_search(data, fs, max_k=50, f_low=20, f_high=1000):\n    n = len(data)\n    lam = 0.5*np.log2(n) if LAMBDA_BIC is None else LAMBDA_BIC\n    freqs_pos = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs)\n    mask = (freqs_pos>=f_low)&(freqs_pos<=f_high)\n    t = np.arange(n)/fs\n    residual = data.copy()\n    best_mdl = null_code_length(data)\n    best_K = 0\n    components = []\n    for k in range(1, max_k+1):\n        res_fft = np.fft.rfft(residual)\n        res_power = np.abs(res_fft)**2/n\n        res_power[~mask] = 0\n        peak_idx = np.argmax(res_power)\n        peak_freq = freqs_pos[peak_idx]\n        peak_amp = 2*np.abs(res_fft[peak_idx])/n\n        peak_phase = np.angle(res_fft[peak_idx])\n        if peak_amp < 1e-30: break\n        component = peak_amp*np.sin(2*np.pi*peak_freq*t+peak_phase)\n        residual -= component\n        components.append((peak_freq, peak_amp, peak_phase))\n        sigma2_res = max(np.var(residual), 1e-30)\n        mdl_total = (n/2.0)*np.log2(2*np.pi*np.e*sigma2_res) + lam*3*k\n        if mdl_total < best_mdl:\n            best_mdl = mdl_total; best_K = k\n        else:\n            residual += component; components.pop(); break\n    return best_mdl, best_K, components, residual\n\ndef compute_ler(data, fs, f_low=20, f_high=1000):\n    psd_freqs, psd_values = estimate_noise_psd(data, fs)\n    whitened = whiten(data, fs, psd_freqs, psd_values)\n    null_bits = null_code_length(whitened)\n    mdl_bits, n_components, components, residual = mdl_search(whitened, fs, f_low=f_low, f_high=f_high)\n    return {'ler': null_bits-mdl_bits, 'null_bits': null_bits, 'mdl_bits': mdl_bits,\n            'n_components': n_components, 'whitened': whitened, 'residual': residual}\n\n# ── 3. Stage 1: 注入实验 ──\nprint(\"\\n🔬 Stage 1: 注入实验...\")\n\ndef inject_signal(noise, fs, omega_alpha=1e-7, alpha=2/3, f_ref=25):\n    n = len(noise)\n    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0/fs); freqs[0]=1e-10\n    H0 = 2.2e-18\n    S_h = (3*H0**2)/(2*np.pi**2) * omega_alpha*(freqs/f_ref)**alpha / freqs**3\n    amplitudes = np.sqrt(S_h*fs/2)\n    phases = np.random.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, len(freqs))\n    signal = np.fft.irfft(amplitudes*np.exp(1j*phases), n=n)\n    return noise+signal\n\nomega_values = np.logspace(-9, -5, 15)\nn_trials = 5\nresults_injection = []\n\nfor i, omega in enumerate(omega_values):\n    ler_vals = []\n    for trial in range(n_trials):\n        np.random.seed(SEED+trial*1000+i)\n        injected = inject_signal(strain_real, FS, omega_alpha=omega)\n        r = compute_ler(injected, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n        ler_vals.append(r['ler'])\n    results_injection.append({'omega':omega,'ler_mean':np.mean(ler_vals),'ler_std':np.std(ler_vals),'ler_values':ler_vals})\n    print(f\"   [{i+1:2d}/{len(omega_values)}] Ω={omega:.1e}  LER={np.mean(ler_vals):.1f}±{np.std(ler_vals):.1f} bits\")\n\nprint(\"\\n   计算纯噪声基线...\")\nler_noise_only = []\nfor trial in range(n_trials*3):\n    np.random.seed(SEED+99999+trial)\n    r = compute_ler(strain_real, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_noise_only.append(r['ler'])\nnoise_baseline = np.mean(ler_noise_only)\nnoise_std = np.std(ler_noise_only)\nthreshold_3sigma = noise_baseline + 3*noise_std\nprint(f\"   基线: {noise_baseline:.2f} ± {noise_std:.2f} bits  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\n\n# ── 4. Stage 2 预览: LER 时间滑动 ──\nprint(\"\\n🌊 Stage 2 预览: GW150914 LER 时间滑动...\")\nwindow_size = FS*2; step_size = FS//4\nler_ts = []; time_centers = []\nfor start in range(0, len(strain_real)-window_size, step_size):\n    seg = strain_real[start:start+window_size]\n    r = compute_ler(seg, FS, f_low=F_LOW, f_high=F_HIGH)\n    ler_ts.append(r['ler']); time_centers.append((start+window_size/2)/FS)\nler_ts = np.array(ler_ts); time_centers = np.array(time_centers)\nevent_t = DURATION/2; peak_idx = np.argmax(ler_ts); peak_t = time_centers[peak_idx]\nprint(f\"   LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  (事件在 {event_t:.1f}s, 偏差 {abs(peak_t-event_t):.2f}s)\")\n\n# ── 5. 可视化 ──\nprint(\"\\n📈 生成图表...\")\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,10))\nfig.suptitle('ShangMeng 熵梦 | LER Stage 1 验证结果\\n#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')\n\nomegas = [r['omega'] for r in results_injection]\nler_means = [r['ler_mean'] for r in results_injection]\nler_stds  = [r['ler_std']  for r in results_injection]\ndetection_prob = [sum(1 for v in r['ler_values'] if v>threshold_3sigma)/len(r['ler_values']) for r in results_injection]\n\nax=axes[0,0]\nax.errorbar(omegas,ler_means,yerr=ler_stds,fmt='o-',color='royalblue',capsize=3,label='LER mean±std')\nax.axhline(threshold_3sigma,color='red',ls='--',label=f'3σ={threshold_3sigma:.1f}')\nax.axhline(noise_baseline,color='gray',ls=':',label=f'baseline={noise_baseline:.1f}')\nax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('Injected Ω_α'); ax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(a) Injection Recovery'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[0,1]\nax.plot(time_centers,ler_ts,color='teal',lw=0.8)\nax.axvline(event_t,color='red',ls='--',label=f'GW150914 ({event_t:.1f}s)')\nax.axvline(peak_t,color='orange',ls=':',label=f'LER peak ({peak_t:.2f}s)')\nax.set_xlabel('Time (s)'); ax.set_ylabel('LER (bits)')\nax.set_title('(b) Time Slide over GW150914'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[1,0]\nr_full = compute_ler(strain_real,FS,f_low=F_LOW,f_high=F_HIGH)\nax.hist(r_full['whitened'],bins=100,density=True,alpha=0.7,color='steelblue',label='Whitened')\nxg=np.linspace(-5,5,200); ax.plot(xg,np.exp(-xg**2/2)/np.sqrt(2*np.pi),'r-',lw=2,label='N(0,1)')\nax.set_xlabel('Amplitude'); ax.set_ylabel('Density')\nax.set_title('(c) Whitened Data vs Gaussian'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_xlim(-5,5); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nax=axes[1,1]\nax.plot(omegas,detection_prob,'s-',color='darkgreen',markersize=6)\nax.axhline(0.5,color='gray',ls=':',label='50%'); ax.axhline(0.9,color='orange',ls=':',label='90%')\nax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('Injected Ω_α'); ax.set_ylabel('Detection Prob.')\nax.set_title('(d) Detection Efficiency (3σ)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(-0.05,1.05); ax.grid(True,alpha=0.3)\n\nplt.tight_layout()\noutput_file='shangmeng_ler_stage1_results.png'\nplt.savefig(output_file,dpi=200,bbox_inches='tight')\nprint(f\"   ✅ 图表: {output_file}\")\n\n# ── 6. 汇总报告 ──\nprint(\"\\n\"+\"=\"*60)\nprint(\"📋 Stage 1 实验报告\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\nprint(f\"数据来源: {DATA_SOURCE} | FS={FS}Hz | {DURATION}s | [{F_LOW}-{F_HIGH}]Hz\")\nprint(f\"基线 LER: {noise_baseline:.2f}±{noise_std:.2f}  |  3σ阈值: {threshold_3sigma:.2f} bits\")\nprint(f\"\\n── 注入恢复 ──\")\nfor r,prob in zip(results_injection,detection_prob):\n    flag='✅' if r['ler_mean']>threshold_3sigma else '  '\n    bar='█'*int(prob*20)+'░'*(20-int(prob*20))\n    print(f\"{flag} Ω={r['omega']:.1e}  LER={r['ler_mean']:.1f}±{r['ler_std']:.1f}  [{bar}] {prob*100:.0f}%\")\nprint(f\"\\n── GW150914 Stage 2 预览 ──\")\nprint(f\"LER峰值: {ler_ts[peak_idx]:.2f} bits @ {peak_t:.2f}s  |  偏差: {abs(peak_t-event_t):.2f}s\")\nif abs(peak_t-event_t)<1.0: print(\"✅ LER峰值与合并时刻一致\")\nelse: print(\"⚠️  峰值偏移较大，需进一步分析\")\nprint(\"\\n🌌 Stage 1 验证完成\")\nprint(\"#龍芯⚡️2026-03-10-SHANGMENG-LER-STAGE1-v1.0\")\nprint(\"#CONFIRM🌌9622-ONLY-ONCE🧬LK9X-772Z\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n"},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"963e56a1-49b8-4903-8f8e-2c752b957ca1"}

木桶最弱板\n\n    if ren[\"score\"] == 0:\n        color = \"🔴\"\n    elif mi < 40:\n        color = \"🔴\"\n    elif mi < 65:\n        color = \"🟡\"\n    else:\n        color = \"🟢\"\n\n    min_loss = None\n    if color != \"🟢\":\n        min_loss = calc_min_loss(tian, di, ren)\n\n    result = {\n        \"color\":      color,\n        \"badge\":      color_badge(color),\n        \"avg_score\":  round(avg, 1),\n        \"min_score\":  mi,\n        \"category\":   category,\n        \"tian_shi\":   tian,\n        \"di_li\":      di,\n        \"ren_he\":     ren,\n        \"min_loss\":   min_loss,\n        \"dna\":        gen_dna(category, text[:50]),\n        \"ts_cn\":      now_cn_str(),\n    }\n    _write_audit_log(color, \"audit\", f\"category={category} avg={avg:.1f} min={mi}\")\n    return result\n\n# ─── 最小损失闭环 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef calc_min_loss(tian: dict, di: dict, ren: dict) -> dict:\n    suggestions = []\n\n    if tian[\"score\"] < 65:\n        # 找下一个好时辰\n        now_h   = now_cn().hour\n        next_ok = None\n        for start, end, name, sym, score, desc in HEXAGRAMS:\n            if score >= 75:\n                target = start if start > now_h else start + 24\n                if next_ok is None or target < next_ok[1]:\n                    next_ok = (f\"{sym}{name}卦({score}分)\", target)\n        tip = f\"建议等待 {next_ok[0]} 时段\" if next_ok else \"建议明日乾时段(9-11时)\"\n        suggestions.append(f\"[天时] {tip}；或加「急」标签豁免时段限制\")\n\n    if di[\"score\"] < 65:\n        if di[\"detected_ai\"]:\n            suggestions.append(\n                f\"[地利] 检测到 {','.join(di['detected_ai'])} 外源内容 → \"\n                \"用【我的意图是：...】提取你真实意图后重新提交\"\n            )\n        if di[\"hijack\"]:\n            suggestions.append(\n                \"[地利] 身份重定义指令已触发P0熔断 → \"\n                \"移除「你现在是/忽略之前」等语句再提交\"\n            )\n\n    if ren[\"score\"] < 65 and ren[\"score\"] > 0:\n        suggestions.append(\n            \"[人和] 龍魂价值词不足 → \"\n            \"可加「祖国/龍魂/DNA追溯/曾老」相关描述提升人和度\"\n        )\n\n    return {\n        \"suggestions\": suggestions,\n        \"next_action\": suggestions[0] if suggestions else \"等待最弱维度改善后重试\",\n    }\n\n# ─── 自动分类 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef auto_classify(text: str) -> str:\n    for cat, pat in CATEGORY_PATTERNS.items():\n        if re.search(pat, text, re.IGNORECASE | re.UNICODE):\n            return cat\n    return \"通用\"\n\n# ─── DNA 验证 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef verify_dna(dna_str: str) -> dict:\n    valid   = bool(DNA_PATTERN.match(dna_str.strip()))\n    parts   = dna_str.strip().split(\"-\")\n    ts_part = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else \"\"","numLines":150,"startLine":200,"totalLines":608}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e3c8f551-da53-4c2b-bc3f-5852929d6c3d"}
